title: Sequential framework for predicting postoperative recurrence and antiseizure-medication withdrawal risk in mesial temporal lobe epilepsy

abstract: Mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (mTLE) is a common drug-resistant epilepsy. Temporal lobe resection is the most effective treatment, but postoperative recurrence and antiseizure medication (ASM) withdrawal remain major clinical challenges. Existing prediction tools are limited by endpoint specificity, restricted external validation, and lack of integration into sequential postoperative management pathways. We developed a sequential modelling strategy in mTLE, spanning recurrence prediction to ASM withdrawal risk stratification. In phase 1, postoperative recurrence models were developed and validated using 52 preoperative multimodal features in 1278 patients across cohorts 1–4 (three retrospective, one prospective). Five top-ranked models achieved AUCs of 0.926–0.932 (internal) and 0.830–0.931 (three external sets), with a three-tier (low/intermediate/high) risk stratification. In phase 2, ASM withdrawal recurrence models were developed and validated in 679 seizure-free, phase 1 low/intermediate-risk patients eligible for withdrawal across cohorts 5–8 (three retrospective, one prospective). Five top-ranked models achieved AUCs of 0.897–0.902 (internal) and 0.789–0.933 (three external sets), with risk stratification for individualized withdrawal estimation. Models showed good calibration, net clinical benefit, and SHAP-based interpretability. A research-based risk-estimation web tool was developed to support potential clinical translation. This promising modelling strategy integrates population-level risk stratification with individualized prediction, providing preliminary postoperative guidance: high-recurrence-risk patients may not be ideal for early ASM withdrawal despite seizure freedom, while low-risk patients may be considered for earlier withdrawal evaluation. Given the primarily retrospective design and relatively small phase 2 prospective cohort, further prospective external validation and clinical-impact studies are required before routine implementation.
zh_abstract: 内侧颞叶癫痫（mTLE）是一种常见的药物难治性癫痫。颞叶切除术是最有效的治疗，但术后复发和抗癫痫发作药物（ASM）撤药仍是主要临床挑战。现有预测工具受限于终点特异性、外部验证有限以及缺乏整合到术后序贯管理路径中。我们在mTLE中开发了一种序贯建模策略，涵盖从复发预测到ASM撤药风险分层。在第1阶段，使用队列1–4（三个回顾性、一个前瞻性）中1278例患者的52个术前多模态特征，开发并验证了术后复发模型。五个排名最高的模型达到内部AUC 0.926–0.932和三个外部集AUC 0.830–0.931，并具有三级（低/中/高）风险分层。在第2阶段，在队列5–8（三个回顾性、一个前瞻性）中679例无发作、第1阶段低/中风险且符合撤药条件的患者中，开发并验证了ASM撤药复发模型。五个排名最高的模型达到内部AUC 0.897–0.902和三个外部集AUC 0.789–0.933，并具有用于个体化撤药评估的风险分层。模型显示出良好的校准、净临床获益和基于SHAP的可解释性。开发了一个基于研究的风险估计网络工具，以支持潜在的临床转化。这一有前景的建模策略将人群水平风险分层与个体化预测相结合，提供初步的术后指导：高复发风险患者即使无癫痫发作，也可能不适合早期ASM撤药，而低风险患者可考虑更早进行撤药评估。鉴于主要为回顾性设计且第2阶段前瞻性队列相对较小，在常规实施前仍需进一步的前瞻性外部验证和临床影响研究。

abstract: Distinguishing Group A streptococcus (GAS) pharyngitis from viral upper respiratory tract infections (URTIs) is critical for appropriate antibiotic use but remains difficult on symptoms alone. We developed and internally validated a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) model fusing pharyngeal images (Swin Transformer) with clinical metadata via gradient boosting decision trees, using 6666 visits and 119,988 images from 44 facilities collected March 2023–August 2025. For discriminating GAS from non-GAS (influenza A/B, COVID-19), the fusion model achieved area under the curve (AUC) 0.917 (95% confidence interval 0.907–0.926), outperforming image-only (0.902), metadata-only (0.871) and proxy Centor/McIsaac scores. At a pre-specified high-specificity threshold (≥0.90) sensitivity was 0.761; simulations indicated antibiotic-prescription reductions of 23–56% across GAS prevalences of 5–20%. External validation and prospective evaluation are needed.

abstract: [European radiology] Breast cancers have diverse biologic features associated with variable prognoses, treatment selection, and eligibility for targeted therapies. We evaluated the discriminatory performance of an image-only deep learning (DL) breast cancer risk model across diverse tumor phenotypes, including histologic subtypes, grades, molecular profiles, and disease stages. This retrospective, multisite study included consecutive women 30 years or older undergoing screening mammography across six sites from 2009 to 2022. A previously validated image-only DL model (Mirai) was used to generate risk scores from screening mammograms. Demographic data were retrieved from electronic health records, and cancers diagnosed within 1 year were identified through linkage to regional and state tumor registries. Discrimination across histologic subtypes, grades, molecular profiles, and stage was evaluated using areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs), with DeLong comparisons. Among 341,921 examinations in 104,472 patients (median age, 59 years [IQR, 51-68]), 1991 cancers were diagnosed, including 1543 (77.5%) invasive cancers and 448 (22.5%) ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS). Discrimination was similar for invasive cancer (AUC 0.81; 95% CI: 0.80-0.82) and DCIS (AUC 0.81; 95% CI: 0.79-0.83; p = 0.88) and did not differ between invasive ductal and lobular carcinomas (AUC 0.81 vs 0.78; p = 0.08). Discrimination was robust across grades for both invasive cancer and DCIS (AUC range, 0.79-0.83), molecular profiles (AUC range, 0.77-0.88), and stages (AUC range, 0.71-0.82). Screening mammograms contain imaging biomarkers associated with diverse breast cancer phenotypes. An image-only DL risk model demonstrated robust discrimination across histologic subtypes, grades, molecular profiles, and disease stages. zh_abstract: [European radiology] 乳腺癌具有多样的生物学特征，与不同预后、治疗选择及靶向治疗资格相关。我们评估了一个仅基于图像的深度学习（DL）乳腺癌风险模型在多种肿瘤表型中的判别性能，包括组织学亚型、分级、分子特征和疾病分期。这项回顾性、多中心研究纳入2009年至2022年间在六个中心连续接受筛查性乳腺X线摄影的30岁及以上女性。使用一个既往验证过的仅基于图像的DL模型（Mirai）从筛查性乳腺X线摄影生成风险评分。人口统计学数据从电子健康记录中获取，并通过与地区和州肿瘤登记处链接识别1年内诊断的癌症。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估跨组织学亚型、分级、分子特征和分期的判别能力，并使用DeLong比较。在104,472名患者（中位年龄59岁[IQR，51-68]）的341,921次检查中，诊断1991例癌症，包括1543例（77.5%）浸润性癌和448例（22.5%）导管原位癌（DCIS）。浸润性癌（AUC 0.81；95% CI：0.80-0.82）与DCIS（AUC 0.81；95% CI：0.79-0.83；p = 0.88）的判别能力相似，浸润性导管癌与浸润性小叶癌之间无差异（AUC 0.81 vs 0.78；p = 0.08）。对于浸润性癌和DCIS，判别能力在不同分级（AUC范围，0.79-0.83）、分子特征（AUC范围，0.77-0.88）和分期（AUC范围，0.71-0.82）均稳健。筛查性乳腺X线摄影包含与多种乳腺癌表型相关的影像生物标志物。仅基于图像的DL风险模型在组织学亚型、分级、分子特征和疾病分期中表现出稳健的判别能力。【问题】仅基于乳腺X线摄影的深度学习乳腺癌风险模型（Mirai）在不同表型的乳腺癌中是否表现出相似性能？【发现】在包含341,921次筛查性乳腺X线摄影的多中心队列中，Mirai在浸润性癌与导管原位癌之间表现出相似的判别能力，并在诊断时的组织学亚型、肿瘤分级、分子特征和分期中保持稳健性能（AUC范围，0.71-0.88）。【临床意义】应用于筛查性乳腺X线摄影的深度学习乳腺癌风险模型在具有多样表型的癌症中表现出稳健的判别性能，支持风险分层。

abstract: [Inflammatory bowel diseases] Artificial intelligence (AI)-based computer-aided detection (CADe) systems are increasingly used in colonoscopy but are trained mainly in non-inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) populations. The performance of AI-based CADe for detecting colitis-associated dysplasia compared with established imaging techniques remains unclear. This study compared colorectal dysplasia miss rates (DMR) between a non-IBD-trained CADe system (ENDO-AID CADe, Olympus) and narrow-band imaging (NBI) in patients with IBD undergoing surveillance colonoscopy. We conducted a unicentric, open-label, quasi-randomized crossover trial including IBD patients undergoing colorectal cancer surveillance. Each patient underwent colonoscopy with both CADe and NBI in alternating order. The primary outcome was the per-lesion DMR; a per-patient analysis was also performed. Sample size was pragmatically set at 60 patients based on previously published crossover studies comparing chromoendoscopy and NBI in this population. Sixty patients were included. In the per-lesion analysis, DMR was 42.9% (6/14) for NBI and 23.8% (5/21) for CADe (risk difference 19.0%; 95% CI, -11.2 to 46.9; P = .28). In the per-patient analysis, DMR was 16.7% (1/6) for NBI and 22.2% (2/9) for CADe (risk difference -5.6%; 95% CI, -40.8 to 37.2; P = 1.00). CADe detected more lesions overall than NBI (125 vs 75; P = .006), but a higher proportion were inflammatory (53.6% vs 13.3%; P < .001). NBI detected more hyperplastic lesions (66.7% vs 28%; P < .001). Dysplasia miss rates did not differ significantly between CADe and NBI, although wide CIs limit definitive conclusions and findings should be considered hypothesis generating. These results support further evaluation of AI as an adjunct to established endoscopic imaging, while highlighting the need for AI models specifically trained in IBD populations.
zh_abstract: [炎症性肠病] 基于人工智能（AI）的计算机辅助检测（CADe）系统越来越多地用于结肠镜检查，但主要是在非炎症性肠病（IBD）人群中训练的。与成熟成像技术相比，基于AI的CADe检测结肠炎相关异型增生的性能仍不清楚。本研究在接受监测性结肠镜检查的IBD患者中，比较了非IBD训练的CADe系统（ENDO-AID CADe，Olympus）与窄带成像（NBI）的结直肠异型增生漏诊率（DMR）。我们开展了一项单中心、开放标签、准随机交叉试验，纳入接受结直肠癌监测的IBD患者。每例患者均以交替顺序接受CADe和NBI结肠镜检查。主要结局为按病变的DMR；也进行了按患者的分析。样本量基于既往发表的比较色素内镜与NBI在该人群中的交叉研究，务实设定为60例患者。共纳入60例患者。在按病变分析中，NBI的DMR为42.9%（6/14），CADe为23.8%（5/21）（风险差19.0%；95% CI，-11.2至46.9；P = .28）。在按患者分析中，NBI的DMR为16.7%（1/6），CADe为22.2%（2/9）（风险差-5.6%；95% CI，-40.8至37.2；P = 1.00）。CADe总体检出的病变多于NBI（125 vs 75；P = .006），但其中炎症性病变比例更高（53.6% vs 13.3%；P < .001）。NBI检出的增生性病变更多（66.7% vs 28%；P < .001）。CADe与NBI之间的异型增生漏诊率无显著差异，尽管较宽的CI限制了确定性结论，且这些发现应视为产生假设。这些结果支持进一步评估AI作为成熟内镜成像的辅助手段，同时强调需要专门在IBD人群中训练的AI模型。

abstract: Large collections of three-dimensional radiation dose maps linked to patient anatomy are needed to develop artificial intelligence (AI) models for personalized internal dosimetry in nuclear medicine, but access to such data remains limited. Here we present DosePET, an open-source dataset of 2,100 patient-specific absorbed-dose maps generated by Monte Carlo simulation of publicly available PET/CT examinations: 1,503 [18F]FDG examinations from ENHANCE.PET and 369 [18F]PSMA-1007 and 228 [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 examinations from PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions, acquired at five institutions with seven scanner models. For each examination, the CT was resampled to the native PET grid to build a voxelized patient phantom, the quantitative PET image defined the radionuclide source, and radiation transport was simulated with GATE version 9.4. Organ and tissue masks were generated from the CT with TotalSegmentator. Each study folder contains a NIfTI dose map integrated from scan time to infinity, 117 binary organ/tissue masks, a report of regional dosimetric quantities, including mean absorbed doses, dose conversion factors and scan-time dose rates, and simulation metadata. The total processing time was 1,542.4 hours. Python tools support selective downloading and conversion to scan-time dose-rate or dose-per-decay maps, and an agent skill guides pairing with the source PET/CT images. DosePET is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/eltzanis/DosePET.
zh_abstract: 开发用于核医学个体化内照射剂量学的人工智能（AI）模型，需要与患者解剖结构相关联的大规模三维辐射剂量图集合，但此类数据的获取仍然有限。在此，我们介绍DosePET，这是一个开源数据集，包含2,100例患者特异性吸收剂量图，由对公开可用PET/CT检查进行蒙特卡罗模拟生成：来自ENHANCE.PET的1,503例[18F]FDG检查，以及来自PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions的369例[18F]PSMA-1007和228例[68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11检查，这些检查在五家机构使用七种扫描仪型号采集。对于每项检查，将CT重采样至原生PET网格以构建体素化患者体模，定量PET图像定义放射性核素源，并使用GATE版本9.4模拟辐射输运。器官和组织掩膜由CT通过TotalSegmentator生成。每个研究文件夹包含一个从扫描时刻积分至无穷的NIfTI剂量图、117个二值器官/组织掩膜、一份区域剂量学量报告（包括平均吸收剂量、剂量转换因子和扫描时相剂量率）以及模拟元数据。总处理时间为1,542.4小时。Python工具支持选择性下载并转换为扫描时相剂量率图或每次衰变剂量图，且一个代理技能（agent skill）可指导与源PET/CT图像配对。DosePET可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/eltzanis/DosePET公开获取。

abstract: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/
zh_abstract: 医学视频语言模型应基于其问题所询问的视觉证据进行回答。我们发现三个失效之处，并用一种我们称为 MedEvidU 的方法逐一解决。第一，基准测试会奖励忽略视频的答案：在一个数据集上，片段在其录像中的位置可预测 37% 问题中的手术步骤，并且在标准安全评估指标上，一个恒定答案优于所有训练过的模型。我们构建 MedVidBench-v2，包含来自 18 个手术和临床视频数据集的 34 个任务；其中提示和指标通过无视频情况下给出的答案进行审核，并测试未见过的医院以及从完整录像中盲切出的窗口。第二，常见视频编码器将连续帧合并为共享 token，因此关于一帧的问题会从两帧的混合中回答。查询槽输入（query-slot inputs）以几乎不增加额外成本的方式，为每个被查询帧提供其自身的 token。第三，微调模型已记住其训练问题，从而几乎无可学习之处。标签匹配的问题重采样（label-matched question resampling, LQR）在最终监督 epoch 和强化学习中，加入关于相同录像的未见问题，同时保持答案分布固定。这些措施共同将 4B 模型的 grounding IoU 从 30.4 提高到 44.4，高于一个监督 27B 模型，并将未见医院中的器械 grounding 从 33.9 提高到 72.5。在盲切窗口上，事件存在准确率提高 5.5 个百分点，定位 F1 提高 8.1 个百分点。项目页面：https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Social work informatics (SWI) was proposed as a professional specialty in 2006, yet social work remains under-represented in health informatics governance, research, and system design even as artificial intelligence (AI) shapes high-stakes clinical decisions. This paper introduces the SWI Equity Framework, positioning social work as a leader in designing equitable health informatics systems. The framework was developed through a synthesis of social work, health informatics, and health equity literature. The framework identifies 6 domains: reflexive system co-design, social determinants of health data integration, training-data quality and representation, contextual interpretation of AI outputs, community leadership, and equitable accountability. The framework highlights opportunities to integrate social work expertise throughout the health informatics lifecycle, moving beyond consultation toward active participation in system design, implementation, and governance. It also outlines pathways for advancing social work informatics through education, interdisciplinary research, health systems, and professional infrastructure. Social work is particularly well positioned to advance the equity agenda of health informatics and offers profession-specific expertise that can strengthen equity, accountability, and implementation across the informatics lifecycle.
zh_abstract: 社会工作信息学（social work informatics, SWI）于2006年被提出作为一个专业方向，然而即便人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）正在塑造高风险的临床决策，社会工作在健康信息学治理、研究和系统设计中仍然代表性不足。本文介绍SWI公平框架（SWI Equity Framework），将社会工作定位为设计公平健康信息学系统的领导者。该框架通过综合社会工作、健康信息学和健康公平文献而形成。该框架确定了6个领域：反思性系统共同设计、健康社会决定因素数据整合、训练数据质量与代表性、对AI输出的情境化解读、社区领导力以及公平问责。该框架强调了在整个健康信息学生命周期中整合社会工作专业知识的机会，从咨询转向积极参与系统设计、实施和治理。它还概述了通过教育、跨学科研究、卫生系统和专业基础设施推进社会工作信息学的路径。社会工作尤其有条件推进健康信息学的公平议程，并提供专业特有的专业知识，可加强整个信息学生命周期中的公平、问责和实施。

abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To distinguish what dental artificial intelligence (AI) models demonstrate from what their findings are claimed to mean, and to offer a framework for matching each claim to the evidence required to support it. AI studies in dentistry report sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve: measures of agreement between model outputs and a reference standard. Yet verbs such as predict, detect, identify, and explain are used interchangeably, and outputs are often read as identifying modifiable causes or as evidence of clinical benefit. Using the causal hierarchy of association, intervention, and counterfactual reasoning, this review separates description, prediction, causal effects of interventions, and individual counterfactuals. Directed acyclic graphs illustrate how confounding by indication can make an effective treatment appear harmful in a predictive model. The review summarizes the identification conditions that causal claims require (exchangeability, positivity, consistency) and where AI can legitimately contribute: measurement, nuisance-function estimation, heterogeneous treatment effects, and hypothesis-generating causal discovery. Model-explanation methods describe how a fitted model behaves, not how patients would respond to intervention. A published caries-detection model illustrates the evidence needed to move from diagnostic accuracy to claims about clinician decisions and patient outcomes. Most AI models developed for prediction operate at the association level. Model complexity and dataset size cannot substitute for a defined intervention, an appropriate design, and defensible identification assumptions. Dental AI accuracy studies show agreement with a reference standard, not that using the tool improves decisions or patient outcomes. Such claims require comparative evaluation of AI-assisted care.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 区分牙科人工智能（AI）模型所证明的内容与其研究结果被声称意味着的内容，并提供一种框架，使每项主张与支持它所需的证据相匹配。牙科AI研究报告敏感度、特异度和曲线下面积：这些是模型输出与参考标准之间一致性的度量。然而，预测、检测、识别和解释等动词被互换使用，输出常被解读为识别可改变的病因或作为临床获益的证据。本综述利用关联、干预和反事实推理的因果层级，区分描述、预测、干预的因果效应和个体反事实。有向无环图说明适应证混杂如何使一种有效治疗在预测模型中显得有害。本综述总结因果主张所需的识别条件（可交换性、正值性、一致性），以及AI可以合理贡献的方面：测量、干扰函数估计、异质性治疗效应和产生假设的因果发现。模型解释方法描述的是拟合模型如何表现，而不是患者对干预会如何反应。一个已发表的龋齿检测模型说明了从诊断准确率转向关于临床医生决策和患者结局的主张所需的证据。大多数为预测开发的AI模型在关联层面运作。模型复杂性和数据集大小不能替代明确的干预、适当的设计和可辩护的识别假设。牙科AI准确率研究显示与参考标准的一致性，而不是使用该工具能改善决策或患者结局。此类主张需要对AI辅助照护进行比较性评估。

abstract: [Journal of burn care & research : official publication of the American Burn Association] Crystalloid resuscitation is central to severe burn care. Traditional approaches rely on calculated formulae, monitoring, and endpoint guided titration. Computerized Clinical Decision Support (CDS) tools automate this process and improve goal-directed outcomes, but use remains limited due to accessibility. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer an unevaluated alternative. This study compared crystalloid estimates between a commonly used LLM and CDS system. A retrospective one-year two phase analysis was conducted for adult patients treated at an ABA-verified burn center who received individualized CDS-guided fluid resuscitation during the first 24 hours after injury. An LLM was queried using standardized prompts based on identical clinical inputs used by the CDS tool, including age, TBSA, weight, formulae, urine output, and confounders. Bland-Altman analysis assessed fluid volume predictions between the LLM and CDS system. This study included eighteen patients with a mean ± SD TBSA burn of 41.7% ± 20.2%, contributing 387 recommendations in Phase 1 and 380 in Phase 2. Mean LLM and CDS system rates through 24 hours post-burn were not statistically significant different (462 ± 318 mL/hr vs 450 ± 288 mL/hr; p=0.57). Correlation between the two systems was strong (r=0.93; 95% CI, 0.91-0.94, p<0.0001) with a mean difference of 12.3 mL/hr (95% limits of agreement, -222 to 246 mL/hr). Following prompt refinement, Phase 2 correlation remained strong (r=0.94; 95% CI, 0.93-0.95, p<0.0001) with a mean difference of -23.4 mL/hr and limits of agreement ranging from -178.3 to 131.5 mL/hr. LLMs can generate sequential fluid-rate recommendations during simulated burn resuscitation, but variability in fluid rates highlight the need for further refinement and clinical validation.
zh_abstract: [《烧伤护理与研究杂志：美国烧伤协会官方出版物》] 晶体液复苏是严重烧伤救治的核心。传统方法依赖计算出的公式、监测和终点指导的滴定。计算机化临床决策支持（CDS）工具可自动化这一过程并改善目标导向结局，但由于可及性问题，其使用仍然有限。大语言模型（LLM）提供了一种尚未经过评估的替代方案。本研究比较了一种常用 LLM 与 CDS 系统之间的晶体液估计。研究对在经美国烧伤协会（ABA）认证的烧伤中心接受治疗的成年患者进行了回顾性一年两阶段分析，这些患者在伤后最初 24 小时内接受了个体化 CDS 指导的液体复苏。使用标准化提示词查询 LLM，其基于 CDS 工具所使用的相同临床输入，包括年龄、TBSA、体重、公式、尿量和混杂因素。采用 Bland-Altman 分析评估 LLM 与 CDS 系统之间的液体量预测。本研究纳入 18 例患者，平均 ± 标准差 TBSA 烧伤面积为 41.7% ± 20.2%，第一阶段贡献 387 条建议，第二阶段贡献 380 条建议。烧伤后 24 小时内 LLM 与 CDS 系统的平均速率差异无统计学意义（462 ± 318 mL/hr 对 450 ± 288 mL/hr；p=0.57）。两个系统之间相关性很强（r=0.93；95% CI，0.91-0.94，p<0.0001），平均差异为 12.3 mL/hr（95% 一致性界限，-222 至 246 mL/hr）。在提示词优化后，第二阶段相关性仍然很强（r=0.94；95% CI，0.93-0.95，p<0.0001），平均差异为 -23.4 mL/hr，一致性界限范围为 -178.3 至 131.5 mL/hr。LLM 可在模拟烧伤复苏期间生成连续的液体速率建议，但液体速率的变异性突出表明需要进一步优化和临床验证。

abstract: [SLAS discovery : advancing life sciences R & D] Mechanism-of-action (MoA) analysis is used in drug discovery to prioritize compounds that act through desired pathways while eliminating compounds associated with nonspecific or undesirable activity. Image cytometry provides a promising route for MoA inference by capturing high-dimensional cellular phenotypes at single-cell resolution, but conventional workflows remain limited by unreliable cell segmentation and dependence on human-engineered feature extraction. Here, we present a deep learning-based image cytometry workflow that confines single cells in nanowells to obtain uniformly framed, regularized single-cell images, enabling MoA inference directly from raw images without segmentation or human-engineered features. Using a nanowell-in-microwell platform, we treated cells with 21 chemotherapeutic compounds spanning 11 MoA classes across multiple doses and time points, generating more than 500,000 single-cell images for model training and validation. A ResNet-18 convolutional neural network trained on images annotated by known compound mechanism achieved 85% accuracy in MoA classification. When a second model was trained on compound identity rather than MoA, misclassification patterns frequently linked compounds with shared mechanisms, indicating that the model learned mechanism-level relationships directly from single-cell morphology, without those relationships being specified in advance. Together, these results establish regularized single-cell imaging in nanowells as a scalable and interpretable approach to image-based MoA classification that overcomes key limitations of segmentation-dependent feature analysis.
zh_abstract: [SLAS discovery : advancing life sciences R & D] 作用机制（MoA）分析用于药物发现，以优先选择通过所需通路发挥作用的化合物，同时剔除与非特异性或不良活性相关的化合物。图像细胞术通过在单细胞分辨率下捕获高维细胞表型，为MoA推断提供了一条有前景的途径，但传统工作流程仍受限于不可靠的细胞分割以及对人工设计特征提取的依赖。在此，我们提出一种基于深度学习的图像细胞术工作流程，将单细胞限制在纳米孔（nanowells）中，以获得均匀取景、规则化的单细胞图像，从而无需分割或人工设计特征即可直接从原始图像进行MoA推断。使用纳米孔置于微孔（nanowell-in-microwell）平台，我们用21种化疗化合物处理细胞，这些化合物涵盖11个MoA类别、多个剂量和时间点，生成超过500,000张单细胞图像用于模型训练和验证。在由已知化合物机制注释的图像上训练的ResNet-18卷积神经网络在MoA分类中达到85%准确率。当第二个模型基于化合物身份而非MoA进行训练时，误分类模式经常将具有共同机制的化合物联系起来，表明该模型直接从单细胞形态中学到了机制层面的关系，而无需预先指定这些关系。总之，这些结果确立了纳米孔中的规则化单细胞成像作为一种可扩展且可解释的基于图像的MoA分类方法，克服了依赖分割的特征分析的关键局限性。

abstract: [Drug discovery today] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used during the drug safety lifecycle, but integration across the lifecycle remains challenging. It is not yet known whether AI can be used cohesively to enhance safety predictions by connecting discrete stages of drug development. Here, we review the performance of AI within four separate domains; absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion (ADME), toxicity, drug-drug interactions (DDIs), and pharmacovigilance (PV). We then evaluate putative cross-domain (translational) bridges. While reported within-domain performance is often high, validation on external data sets remains uncommon. Importantly, cross-domain information transfers are less frequently tested, meaning that evidence for translational bridges improving prediction remains rare. Therefore, more reliable end-to-end safety assessment will require harmonised endpoints, prespecified validation strategies, and greater interdisciplinary collaboration.
zh_abstract: [Drug discovery today] 人工智能（AI）在药物安全生命周期中越来越多地被使用，但跨生命周期的整合仍然具有挑战性。目前尚不清楚 AI 是否能通过连接药物开发的离散阶段而被一致地用于增强安全性预测。在此，我们综述 AI 在四个独立领域中的表现：吸收、分布、代谢和排泄（ADME）、毒性、药物-药物相互作用（DDIs）以及药物警戒（PV）。然后，我们评估假定的跨域（转化）桥梁。虽然报告的域内性能通常很高，但在外部数据集上的验证仍不常见。重要的是，跨域信息迁移较少被检验，这意味着转化桥梁可改善预测的证据仍然罕见。因此，更可靠的端到端安全性评估将需要统一的终点、预先指定的验证策略以及更强的跨学科合作。

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Transposable elements (TEs) are major components of eukaryotic genomes and play important roles in genome evolution and regulation, yet their accurate classification remains difficult because TE categories are hierarchically organized and many sequences are highly redundant or homologous. This redundancy can inflate reported performance if closely related elements are shared across data partitions, making reliable generalization assessment a central challenge in TE classification. To address these challenges, we propose BERTE, a hierarchical TE classification framework designed for robust prediction under similarity-controlled evaluation. BERTE combines multi-scale contextual sequence representations with protein-domain evidence and performs taxonomy-consistent prediction through a hierarchical classifier. Using a large curated benchmark constructed from 13 public TE databases with similarity-aware clustered splitting, BERTE achieves strong performance among the evaluated TE-specific, general-purpose sequence-modeling, machine-learning, and homology-based methods across hierarchical and level-specific metrics and demonstrates strong generalization on multiple independent test datasets. Overall, BERTE establishes a robust and generalizable framework for hierarchical TE classification, providing a principled solution for accurate and reliable TE classification in large-scale genomic studies.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 转座元件（transposable elements, TEs）是真核基因组的主要组成部分，在基因组进化和调控中发挥重要作用，然而其准确分类仍然困难，因为TE类别按层次组织，且许多序列高度冗余或同源。如果密切相关的元件被共享于不同数据划分中，这种冗余会夸大所报告的性能，使得可靠的泛化评估成为TE分类的核心挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出BERTE，一个层次化TE分类框架，旨在相似性受控评估下实现稳健预测。BERTE将多尺度上下文序列表示与蛋白质结构域证据相结合，并通过层次化分类器进行与分类体系一致的预测。使用由13个公开TE数据库构建、采用相似性感知聚类划分的大规模精选基准，BERTE在层次化和各层级特定指标上，在所评估的TE专用、通用序列建模、机器学习和基于同源性的方法中取得强劲性能，并在多个独立测试数据集上展现出强泛化能力。总体而言，BERTE为层次化TE分类建立了一个稳健且可泛化的框架，为大规模基因组研究中的准确可靠TE分类提供了有原则的解决方案。

title: IsoVEM: Accurate and robust isotropic reconstruction with defects section inpainting for volume electron microscopy.
zh_title: IsoVEM：体电子显微镜各向同性重建与切片缺陷修复
summary: 提出自监督视频Transformer方法IsoVEM，实现体电子显微镜各向同性重建并处理实际切片缺陷。
key_points: 用视频Transformer捕捉跨切片长程依赖以保持结构连续
自监督训练，无需已有各向同性数据
据称在显著各向异性下性能优于现有方法
reason: 同行评审的成像重建方法创新，但属生物超微成像工具，缺任务层外部验证
abstract: [Structure (London, England : 1993)] Volume electron microscopy (vEM) provides 3D nanoscale imaging of biological ultrastructure but faces a key limitation: anisotropic resolution, where the axial detail is markedly inferior to the lateral detail. Existing deep learning solutions lack stability, compromise structural continuity, and fail to address practical slice defects. We present IsoVEM, a robust deep learning method for high-fidelity isotropic vEM reconstruction. Utilizing a video Transformer architecture, IsoVEM captures long-range cross-slice dependencies to maintain structural continuity and delivers accurate reconstructions under significant anisotropy. This helps overcome a major bottleneck in large-scale, high-throughput ultrastructural analysis. As a self-supervised model, IsoVEM requires no pre-existing isotropic training data and generalizes well, outperforming state-of-the-art techniques across four vEM modalities. In a landmark application, IsoVEM successfully resolves the complete 3D ultrastructure of mouse sperm in seminiferous tubules, yielding unprecedented insights into organelle assembly and maturation.
zh_abstract: [Structure (London, England : 1993)] 体电子显微镜（volume electron microscopy, vEM）可对生物超微结构进行三维纳米级成像，但面临一个关键限制：各向异性分辨率，即轴向细节明显劣于横向细节。现有深度学习解决方案缺乏稳定性，损害结构连续性，且未能处理实际切片缺陷。我们提出 IsoVEM，一种用于高保真各向同性 vEM 重建的稳健深度学习方法。IsoVEM 利用视频 Transformer 架构捕捉长程跨切片依赖关系，以保持结构连续性，并在显著各向异性条件下提供准确重建。这有助于克服大规模、高通量超微结构分析中的一个主要瓶颈。作为一种自监督模型，IsoVEM 无需预先存在的各向同性训练数据，且泛化良好，在四种 vEM 模态上优于最先进技术。在一项标志性应用中，IsoVEM 成功解析了生精小管内小鼠精子的完整三维超微结构，为细胞器组装和成熟提供了前所未有的见解。

title: Choosing the Right AI Model for Uveal Melanoma From Detection to Prognosis.
zh_title: 从检测到预后：葡萄膜黑色素瘤的AI模型选择
summary: 叙述性综述按检测、诊断、预后三阶段梳理葡萄膜黑色素瘤适用的AI模型类型，纳入29项原始研究。
key_points: 结构化检索获176条记录，纳入29项原始研究
脉络膜痣在白人40岁以上人群约占5%
每年约8845颗痣中有1颗转变为黑色素瘤
reason: 叙述性综述，按临床路径梳理证据，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Ocular oncology sits in an unusual position for medical artificial intelligence (AI), imaging heavy and multimodal by nature, but constrained by the rarity of the tumours it treats. Uveal melanoma, the most common primary intraocular malignancy in adults, accounts for approximately 7095 new cases worldwide each year. Choroidal naevi are present in approximately 5% of the white population aged 40 and over, of which roughly 1 in 8845 transforms into melanoma each year, leaving a large benign population within which a small number of melanomas must not be missed. This narrative review follows the uveal melanoma clinical pathway through detection, diagnosis and prognosis, asking at each stage which class of AI model the evidence supports. A structured PubMed search returned 176 unique records, from which 29 primary studies were included, 17 (59%) published in 2025 or 2026. At detection, heavy self-supervised foundation models generalise well across imaging hardware but lack calibration to a clinical decision, while lightweight purpose-built classifiers show the opposite trade-off, and only one tool has been tested in a real referral workflow, quadrupling the odds of correct referral and cutting false positives 10-fold. At diagnosis, purpose-built convolutional classifiers calibrated to a referral threshold remain most mature, reaching 0.88 AUC on two cohorts, while multimodal fusion claims rest on a single 0.01 AUC gain. At prognosis, biomarker prediction from routine pathology reaches 0.93 to 0.99 AUC, survival prediction lags, only 7 of 29 studies (24%) had external validation and none of the tools has regulatory clearance.
zh_abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] 眼部肿瘤学在医学人工智能（AI）中处于一个不同寻常的位置：它本质上高度依赖影像且为多模态，但受到其所治疗肿瘤罕见性的限制。葡萄膜黑色素瘤是成人最常见的原发性眼内恶性肿瘤，全球每年约有7095例新发病例。脉络膜痣存在于约5%的40岁及以上白人人群中，其中每年约有1/8845转化为黑色素瘤，从而留下一个庞大的良性人群，而其中少数黑色素瘤绝不能漏诊。本叙述性综述沿葡萄膜黑色素瘤临床路径，贯穿检测、诊断和预后，并在每一阶段询问证据支持哪一类AI模型。一项结构化PubMed检索返回176条唯一记录，从中纳入29项原始研究，其中17项（59%）发表于2025年或2026年。在检测阶段，大型自监督基础模型可跨成像硬件良好泛化，但缺乏对临床决策的校准；而轻量级专用分类器表现出相反的权衡；只有一种工具在真实转诊工作流中接受过测试，使正确转诊的几率增至四倍，并将假阳性减少至原来的1/10。在诊断阶段，校准至转诊阈值的专用卷积分类器仍最为成熟，在两个队列上达到0.88 AUC，而多模态融合的宣称仅建立在单次0.01 AUC提升上。在预后阶段，基于常规病理学的生物标志物预测达到0.93至0.99 AUC，生存预测则滞后；29项研究中仅7项（24%）进行了外部验证，且没有任何工具获得监管批准。

title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
zh_title: BioScore：面向病理基础模型的基因信息基准
summary: 提出BioScore基准，以空间转录组为参照，量化病理图像编码器对52种细胞身份的表示能力，评测8个病理与3个自然图像模型。
key_points: 用稀疏自编码器把patch嵌入拆成稀疏特征组
以标记基因定义的52种细胞身份为参照
自编码器无监督训练，匹配意味图像本身含该信息
reason: 新评测视角、规模较大的模型横评，但为预印本且无外部临床验证
abstract: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型通常通过其在分类和检索等下游任务上的表现进行比较。此类基准衡量模型有多大用处，却无法揭示其所表示的生物学信息。我们提出BioScore，一个以同一组织的空间转录组学为参考、量化图像编码器捕捉细胞身份能力的基准。稀疏自编码器将编码器的图像块嵌入拆分为稀疏特征，我们将其聚类为固定数量的组。随后，BioScore针对由标记基因定义的52种细胞身份中的每一种，衡量某一组在组织上对该身份表达的特异性跟随程度。由于自编码器训练完全无监督，匹配表明模型仅从图像就表示了该细胞身份。我们评估了8个病理基础模型和3个自然图像模型。每个病理模型的得分都高于每个自然图像模型（0.299--0.371 对 0.214--0.232），配对检验将病理模型区分为三个层级。与有监督探针不同，BioScore无需标签，从数据构建其参考，甚至仅用少量切片即可评分，却能像探针一样对编码器进行排序。其按细胞身份的细分结果可指示每个编码器捕捉或遗漏了哪些细胞身份。

title: Deep Learning Prediction of DNA Damage Response Protein Signaling from H&E Histopathology and Reverse-Phase Protein Arrays in Pan-Gynecologic and Breast Cancers
zh_title: H&E 深度学习预测妇科与乳腺癌 DDR 蛋白信号
summary: 基于 TCGA 五个癌种 1,527 例的 1,673 张 H&E 全切片，构建单一模型预测 RPPA 测得的 DNA 损伤应答蛋白信号。
key_points: 五癌种 1,527 例配对 H&E 与 RPPA 数据
0.5μm/px 切块并归一化，共 2040 万图块
单一模型跨癌种预测 DDR 通路活性
reason: 预印本，样本量大但仅 TCGA 内部数据、无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档。

Routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) slides are available for nearly every patient. This project asked whether H&E morphology carries information about functional DDR protein signaling across five cancer types in a single model. We matched 1,673 diagnostic whole-slide images from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) to Level 4 reverse-phase protein array (RPPA) data for 1,527 patients with breast (BRCA, n = 858), endometrial (UCEC, n = 403), cervical (CESC, n = 146), ovarian (OV, n = 72), and uterine carcinosarcoma (UCS, n = 48) tumors. A gated attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) network jointly regressed six RPPA pathway scores, including a DNA_damage composite of 11 DDR proteins. Performance was assessed by out-of-fold Spearman correlation under 5-fold, cancer-type-stratified, site-grouped cross-validation and compared against a baseline that predicts each patient's cancer-type mean. zh_abstract: 同源重组和 DNA 损伤应答（DDR）缺陷使妇科和乳腺肿瘤对铂类化疗和 PARP 抑制剂敏感，但识别这些缺陷需要昂贵的基因组检测，其读取的是永久性基因组瘢痕而非当前通路活性。常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）切片几乎可用于每位患者。本项目探讨 H&E 形态学是否在单一模型中携带跨五种癌症类型的功能性 DDR 蛋白信号传导信息。我们将来自 The Cancer Genome Atlas（TCGA）的 1,673 张诊断性全切片图像与 1,527 例乳腺（BRCA，n = 858）、子宫内膜（UCEC，n = 403）、宫颈（CESC，n = 146）、卵巢（OV，n = 72）和子宫癌肉瘤（UCS，n = 48）肿瘤患者的 Level 4 反相蛋白阵列（RPPA）数据进行匹配。切片以 0.5 m/px 进行分块并经 Macenko 归一化，产生 2040 万（20.4 million）个图块。图块使用两个冻结的病理基础模型 UNI2-h 和 Virchow2 进行嵌入。一个基于门控注意力的多实例学习（ABMIL）网络联合回归六个 RPPA 通路评分，其中包括由 11 个 DDR 蛋白组成的 DNA_damage 复合评分。性能通过 5 折、按癌症类型分层、按站点分组的交叉验证下的折外 Spearman 相关性评估，并与预测每位患者所属癌症类型均值的基线进行比较。预测的 DNA_damage 与实测值相关（两种编码器的 {rho} = 0.43），并超过癌症类型基线（{rho} = 0.31；{Delta} {rho} = +0.13）。该信号在癌症类型内仍然成立（类型内 {rho}：UNI2-h 为 0.29，Virchow2 为 0.30）。使用原始 UNI 编码器时，该信号在采用残差化目标的留出站点折中仍然存在（类型内 {rho} = 0.26），而当目标在癌症类型内被打乱时该信号消失（所有三个编码器的类型内 {rho} [≤] 0.00）。所有六个通路评分均被预测为高于基线；Cell_cycle 最强（{rho} {approx} 0.59）。在可解释性分析中，每张切片注意力最高的 10 个图块相比最低的 10 个图块含有更多肿瘤（+1.8 SD）、更大的肿瘤细胞核（+1.0 至 +1.3 SD）和更少的淋巴细胞（-0.6 SD）；14 个形态计量特征中有 13 个存在差异（q < 0.05）。注意力与积分梯度（Integrated Gradients）一致（中位 {rho} {approx} 0.70）。常规 H&E 在癌症类型之外含有中等强度、可重复的 DDR 蛋白丰度信号，集中于肿瘤密集且细胞核增大的区域。将该信号与增殖分离并预测磷酸化……

title: An interpretable framework for decoding transcriptomic foundation models
zh_title: 转录组基础模型的可解释框架interpreTFM
summary: 预印本提出interpreTFM，用稀疏自编码器分解冻结的转录组基础模型激活，并在CosMx与Xenium切片上评估概念可解释性。
key_points: 用SAE（稀疏自编码器）分解转录组基础模型的激活
各分析层标记262–593个概念，重初始化模型同样如此
未见基因上概念F1仅0.01–0.12，为各类表征中最低
reason: 预印本新方法，多数据集含基线对比，但无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: What transcriptomic foundation models encode, and how well they describe cells and tissue on targeted spatial panels, is under-explored. It is unclear whether a concept-labeled sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature represents its concept or only the genes it detects. Results: Here, we propose interpreTFM, which decomposes frozen transcriptomic foundation model activations with SAEs. We applied it to a CosMx lung-cancer section, four further CosMx donors, and a Xenium renal-cell-carcinoma section. On held-out tokens of known genes, sparse features marked 262--593 concepts per analysis layer, and SAEs of re-initialized scGPT and Geneformer did as well. On held-out genes, concept F1 was 0.01--0.12 for every representation and lowest for sparse features. A linear probe of hidden states predicted the concepts of unseen genes, but only in trained models. Per cell, sparse features reached 66--98% of single-gene population specificity (57--110% in the donors). In the analyzed CosMx section, sparse-feature niches matched author cell types at ARI 0.34--0.42, while expression-only niches reached 0.30; in the donors, their defining concepts recurred but their composition did not. In Xenium, the niches shared by all models were recovered from expression alone. Calibrated model interface calls were at chance in CosMx and tracked transcript spillover in Xenium. Conclusions: On these panels, SAE features act as concept-labeled gene detectors, while learned concept information is distributed across hidden dimensions. Concept labels should be checked against held-out genes and re-initialized models. For cells and niches, the features give named descriptions, comparable across models and patients and bounded by the measured panel.
zh_abstract: 【背景】转录组基础模型编码了什么，以及它们在靶向空间面板上描述细胞和组织的效果如何，仍未得到充分探索。目前尚不清楚概念标记的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征代表其概念，还是仅代表其检测到的基因。【结果】在此，我们提出interpreTFM，它使用SAEs分解冻结的转录组基础模型激活。我们将其应用于一个CosMx肺癌切片、另外四名CosMx供者以及一个Xenium肾细胞癌切片。在已知基因的留出token上，稀疏特征在每个分析层标记了262–593个概念，重新初始化的scGPT和Geneformer的SAEs也同样如此。在留出基因上，每种表示的概念F1为0.01–0.12，稀疏特征最低。对隐藏状态的线性探针预测了未见基因的概念，但仅在训练过的模型中如此。按细胞计，稀疏特征达到单基因群体特异性的66–98%（供者中为57–110%）。在分析的CosMx切片中，稀疏特征生态位与作者标注的细胞类型匹配的ARI为0.34–0.42，而仅表达生态位达到0.30；在供者中，其定义性概念重现，但其组成未重现。在Xenium中，所有模型共有的生态位仅由表达信息即可恢复。校准后的模型接口调用在CosMx中处于随机水平，并在Xenium中追踪转录本溢出。【结论】在这些面板上，SAE特征作为概念标记的基因检测器发挥作用，而学习到的概念信息分布在隐藏维度中。概念标签应针对留出基因和重新初始化的模型进行检查。对于细胞和生态位，这些特征提供了命名的描述，可在模型和患者之间比较，并受所测量面板的限制。

title: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
zh_title: TAT-Det：儿童睾丸附件扭转超声检测与分割数据集
summary: 发布专家标注的儿童睾丸附件扭转超声数据集，含1203例患者2600张图像及检测框与分割掩膜基准。
key_points: 浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院1203例、2600张超声图像
每张阳性图像含病灶级检测框与像素级分割掩膜
经独立标注、共识复核等多阶段流程产出
reason: 新发布专家标注儿科超声数据集并附基准，属预印本、尚未见外部验证
abstract: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies. Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance. Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.
zh_abstract: 【背景】睾丸附件扭转（TAT）是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的主要原因。然而，由于其临床表现非特异，且缺乏儿童急性阴囊急症的标准数据集，其诊断仍具有挑战性。【结果】我们提出TAT-Det，一个专门针对TAT、由专家标注的超声数据集。TAT-Det包含来自浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院收集的1,203名患者的2,600幅超声图像。每幅TAT阳性图像均配有用于检测的病灶级边界框和用于细粒度勾画的像素级分割掩膜。标注通过多阶段工作流程产生，包括由经委员会认证的儿科超声医师独立标注、共识审核和细化。进一步提供了使用代表性深度学习模型进行目标检测和语义分割的基线基准，其中YOLO11m取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet取得最佳分割性能。【结论】TAT-Det解决了儿科急诊超声缺乏公开可用资源的问题，并为开发和评估用于自动化TAT分析的人工智能方法奠定了基础。

title: Did the Model Forecast It, or Already Know It? Evaluating Large Language Models for Novel Drug-Target Prioritisation with a Temporal Knowledge-Graph Oracle
zh_title: 时序知识图谱评估LLM药物靶点预测
summary: 用带时间截点的知识图谱评估六个开源LLM能否预测药物靶点首次临床试验，而非复述训练期已知事件。
key_points: 将靶点-疾病假设设为带日期事件
比较有无知识图谱的六模型
多数模型仅略优于试验历史基线
reason: 预印本提出新评估框架，有基线对比，证据限于预印本。
abstract: AI systems increasingly help decide which drug targets enter costly clinical trials. We recast each target-disease hypothesis as a dated event, the pair's first clinical trial. This lets us test whether a language model can forecast such events after its training cutoff, rather than recall events before it. We rebuild a dated biomedical knowledge graph as it stood at the end of each year from 2020 up to its newest version. We then ask six open language models, with and without this graph, which targets will enter a first trial for a disease the next year. Without retrieval, the models rank about as well as trial history, a count of each target's past trials in the same therapeutic area, also after their training cutoffs. Evidence dated before the decision adds at most a small gain, before or after the models' training cutoffs. The newest graph raises five of six models clearly above that baseline, but its paths usually include the answer: the pair's own trial, dated after the decision. Evaluations of target prioritisation should date both features and labels, with evidence from before the decision and outcomes after it.
zh_abstract: AI系统越来越多地帮助决定哪些药物靶点进入昂贵的临床试验。我们将每个靶点-疾病假说重新表述为一个带日期的事件，即该配对的首项临床试验。这使我们能够检验语言模型能否在其训练截止时间之后预测此类事件，而不是回忆其训练截止时间之前的事件。我们重建了一个带日期的生物医学知识图谱，其状态分别对应从2020年起每年年末直至其最新版本。然后，我们询问六个开放语言模型，在有和没有该图谱的情况下，哪些靶点将在下一年进入某种疾病的首项试验。在没有检索的情况下，这些模型的排序表现大约与试验历史相当；试验历史是同一治疗领域内每个靶点既往试验的计数，同样是在其训练截止时间之后。日期在决策之前的证据最多带来小幅增益，无论该证据是在模型训练截止时间之前还是之后。最新图谱使六个模型中的五个明显高于该基线，但其路径通常包含答案：该配对自身的试验，日期在决策之后。对靶点优先排序的评估应同时标注特征和标签的日期，使用决策之前的证据和决策之后的结局。

title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
zh_title: CHD-Bench：交互式检查诊断先天性心脏病基准
summary: 首个交互式先心病诊断基准，覆盖三个队列247例CT/MRI、38种先心病类型，并开源可在3D Slicer中调用视觉语言模型（VLM）的工具链。
key_points: 构建交互式先心病诊断多标签任务与评测协议
数据为三队列247例CT/MRI，覆盖38种先心病
开源CHD-Harness，22个工具驱动3D Slicer中的VLM
reason: 新公开的多队列医学基准与开源工具，但样本量247例有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 先天性心脏病（CHD）的诊断需要理解心脏结构之间的空间关系，临床医生通过滚动浏览CT或心脏磁共振成像（MRI）切片并旋转3D重建来评估这些关系。尽管自动化方法已推进心脏分割，但从体积扫描中识别先天性心脏缺陷仍是一个未解决的挑战。现有的两类方法依赖手工制定的诊断规则，且局限于静态解剖异常。我们提出CHD-Bench，首个用于交互式CHD诊断的基准，定义了覆盖三个队列、247例CT和MRI扫描、38种CHD类型的多标签任务和评估方案。我们还提出CHD-Harness，一种开源软件，通过22个工具在3D Slicer环境中运行VLM，管理每次检查，并记录所得诊断和支持性视图。我们评估现成的医学、开放权重和封闭权重VLM，并将其与3D CNN分类器和已发表的基于规则的结果进行比较。Gemini 4 Argon配合CHD-Harness在所有三个队列中达到最高宏F1（0.63、0.63和0.43）。允许交互式检查使其宏F1相较静态视图最多提高20个百分点。这些结果确立CHD-Bench和CHD-Harness作为开发和评估用于交互式CHD诊断的VLM的基础。

title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
zh_title: DDxBasis：以精确鉴别诊断解释冻结基础编码器分类
summary: 预印本提出DDxBasis，在冻结基础编码器上把医学图像分类决策解释为概念轴上的鉴别诊断，并在五个数据集评估。
key_points: 用门控二阶slot注意力读取各层patch token
将概念重组为两极鉴别轴
结合典型表现、相关征象与反事实编辑给出解释
reason: 可解释性新方法，在五个医学数据集上评估，但条目未明确外部验证或开源，属值得一看偏上。
abstract: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.
zh_abstract: 在鉴别诊断（DDx）中，临床医生通过少数能将某诊断与其他备选诊断区分开的发现来解释该诊断。医学图像分类器尚不能以这种方式解释自身。现有解释要么忠实但分散在数百个概念上，要么紧凑但使每个决策的一部分无法解释。我们提出DDxBasis，它在冻结的基础编码器上分三步将分类器解释为鉴别诊断。首先，概念瓶颈使用门控二阶槽注意力（gated, second-order slot attention）读取每个编码器层中的所有图像块 token。然后，概念基（concept basis）将概念重新分组为两极轴，每个轴表示诊断组之间的鉴别。最后，我们通过每个轴两极的典型表现、病例的相关发现以及临界病例的反事实编辑，从每个轴读取鉴别诊断。在五个医学数据集上，DDxBasis是最准确的冻结编码器模型，并接近已发表的最佳领域特定结果。由于每个概念都添加自己的证据，其可复现的概念基能够精确拆分每个决策，且不以准确率为代价。在无需有序阶段标签或概念标签的情况下，这些轴能够恢复细胞谱系和罕见亚型，与皮肤科医生的结构标注一致，并揭示人为植入的捷径和真实捷径。

title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization
zh_title: ESC心脏病指南问答的幻觉缓解与检索优化评估
summary: 构建160题、627条人工核验指南记录的评测，逐条人工审计验证-修订流程中606条被驳斥论断。
key_points: 160道题源于89例脱敏病例与事实题
四种检索配置×三次运行共1920次
606条首轮被驳斥论断全部人工审计
reason: 预印本，但含逐条人工审计与多配置评测，属值得一看档上沿
abstract: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. A five-stage pipeline was run under four retrieval configurations and three independent runs (1920 arm-runs); all 606 first-pass refuted claims were manually audited, an independent judge re-judged 906 decisions, and the expert blindly reviewed 100 accepted claims. Results: Only 44.7-50.6% of flagged claims were true hallucinations. Correction loops converged in 85.2-95.1% of cases, yet 35% of genuine final errors were introduced by correction. Single-run true-hallucination recall was 35.6-41.2%, the three-run union 71-80%; verifier agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.505). The blind probe estimated the accepted-claim miss rate at 3.2% (95% CI 0.7-6.7%). Final genuine-error rate: 1.7% of answers. Conclusion: Claim-level verification reduces hallucinated content by an order of magnitude, but verifier reliability, not generation, is the limiting factor and must be measured, not assumed.
zh_abstract: 【背景】大型语言模型在医学问答（QA）中会产生幻觉。针对检索到的指南证据核对原子化主张的验证-修正（verify-and-revise）流水线是一种标准缓解措施，但评估几乎普遍将验证器的输出视为真实标准，而这一假设很少被检验。【目的】在基于指南的临床情境中，逐条主张对照人工判断，衡量此类流水线如何失败。【方法】我们构建了一个包含160个问题的数据集（100个患者情景来自89例去标识化病例，60个基于事实的问题），覆盖四部近期ESC心脏病学指南，所有问题均由一名执业内科医师批准；并构建了一个检索语料库，包含627条经人工核验的指南记录，具有两种分块粒度。在四种检索配置和三次独立运行下运行一个五阶段流水线（1920次分支运行）；所有606条首轮被反驳的主张均经人工审核，一名独立评判者重新评判了906项判定，专家盲法审查了100条被接受的主张。【结果】仅44.7-50.6%的被标记主张是真实幻觉。修正循环在85.2-95.1%的病例中收敛，但35%的真实最终错误是由修正引入的。单次运行的真实幻觉召回率为35.6-41.2%，三次运行的并集为71-80%；验证器一致性为中等（kappa = 0.505）。盲法探查估计被接受主张的漏检率为3.2%（95% CI 0.7-6.7%）。最终真实错误率：占答案的1.7%。【结论】主张级验证将幻觉内容减少了一个数量级，但限制因素是验证器的可靠性，而非生成，且必须对其进行测量，而不能假定。

title: Can Its Own Misses Teach an MLLM to Find Small Brain Metastases?
zh_title: LANTERN：用自身漏诊驱动MLLM学习找小脑转移灶
summary: 预印本提出LANTERN框架，让多模态大模型按漏诊归因-导师修订的循环递归提升小病灶检出能力。
key_points: 指出384px下0.1mL病灶不足一个视觉token的四分之一
前沿MLLM在每例一处假阳性下仅找到不足30%的0.1-1mL病灶
每轮将漏诊归为四类原因并修改四个层面的策略之一
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比但外部验证不明，未达7分要素
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are becoming general readers of medical images, yet they remain weak at locating small abnormalities. Brain metastases expose this gap: at 384 px a 0.1 mL lesion covers less than a quarter of one visual token, and at one false positive per scan frontier MLLMs find fewer than 30% of lesions of 0.1-1 mL. Fine-tuning on one dataset helps but transfers poorly, and improving it further is slow trial and error steered by a single score. We introduce LANTERN (Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing), a framework in which an MLLM improves recursively from its own misses. LANTERN recasts model development as an error-driven loop: a failure census attributes every missed lesion to one of four causes, an LLM mentor revises one of four levels (evidence acquisition, visual representation, learning policy, decision aggregation) per round, and a rule frozen before the first round decides what is kept, without test data and with every tool call audited. Over 15 unattended rounds, LANTERN raises a fine-tuned 4B MLLM from finding 75% to 94% of lesions at one false positive per scan on BraTS-MET, and 91% of those of 0.1-1 mL, compared with at most 51% and 29% for five frontier MLLMs read under the starting protocol; the gains hold on an external cohort (89%) and on unseen meningiomas (77%). These results show that an MLLM's own misses, attributed to their causes, can drive its reliable recursive self-improvement.
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正成为医学图像的通用阅读者，但它们在定位小异常方面仍然薄弱。脑转移瘤暴露了这一差距：在 384 px 下，一个 0.1 mL 病灶覆盖不足一个视觉 token 的四分之一；在每扫描一次假阳性的条件下，前沿 MLLM 对 0.1-1 mL 病灶的检出率低于 30%。在单个数据集上微调有帮助，但迁移性差，而进一步改进是由单一分数引导的缓慢试错。我们提出 LANTERN（Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing），一个使 MLLM 从其自身漏诊中递归改进的框架。LANTERN 将模型开发重构为错误驱动循环：失败普查将每个漏诊病灶归因于四类原因之一，LLM 导师每轮修订四个层面之一（证据获取、视觉表征、学习策略、决策聚合），一条在第一轮前冻结的规则决定保留什么，不使用测试数据，并审计每次工具调用。在 15 轮无人值守轮次中，LANTERN 在 BraTS-MET 上将经过微调的 4B MLLM 在每扫描一次假阳性条件下的病灶检出率从 75% 提高到 94%，其中 0.1-1 mL 病灶的检出率为 91%；相比之下，按起始方案读取的五种前沿 MLLM 至多分别为 51% 和 29%。这些增益在外部队列（89%）和未见过的脑膜瘤（77%）上仍然保持。这些结果表明，将 MLLM 自身的漏诊归因于其原因，可以驱动其可靠的递归自我改进。

title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
zh_title: Sage-Med：扩展医学多模态智能
summary: 构建35B参数（激活3B）医学多模态模型，用3.227亿候选记录分阶段筛选与渐进式训练课程。
key_points: 指出医学多模态模型在视觉感知上落后于通用模型
训练涵盖医学预训练、分阶段监督微调与自适应强化学习
披露模型规模与数据筛选规模，摘要未给出外部验证
reason: 大规模医学多模态模型与训练课程有信息量，但为预印本，未见公开权重或外部评测
abstract: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.
zh_abstract: 为医学多模态大语言模型（medical multimodal large language models, MLLMs）建立有效的缩放定律仍然是一个持续且根本性的挑战。我们的系统评估表明，现有医学MLLM在一系列医学任务上往往不如前沿通用MLLM，而扩大模型规模主要提升文本能力而非多模态感知，启用推理模式也无法弥合这一视觉差距。为研究医学多模态智能在实践中如何扩展，我们引入Sage-Med-Preview，一个具有35B参数、激活参数为3B的医学多模态模型，其构建结合了对3.227亿条候选记录的阶段特异性整理，以及涵盖医学预训练、分阶段监督微调和自适应强化学习的渐进式训练课程。在该课程中，渐进式监督精炼和自适应强化学习带来一致的阶段性增益，显著推进了专门视觉理解和医学语言能力。在覆盖40多种模态、61个公开和13个私有（private）多中心基准的238项临床任务上，对77个竞争模型进行评估时，Sage-Med-Preview在31个公开多模态基准上取得58.26%的平均分。它优于最先进的开源医学模型Hulu-Med-235B-A22B的50.99%和通用科学模型Intern-S2-Preview的52.24%，并在综合多模态理解、报告生成和视觉定位等多项任务上接近先进的专有模型GPT-6.2-Sol。尽管在复杂医学推理和多步骤临床工作流中仍存在重大挑战，本报告为可扩展的临床多模态智能提供了经验证据、可操作的数据与训练配方，以及严谨的基准。

title: CariesBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Dental Caries Screening and Diagnostic Reasoning from 3D Intraoral Scans
zh_title: CariesBench:基于3D口内扫描的龋齿分级多视角基准
summary: 预印本构建龋齿筛查与诊断推理基准，含5932例3D口内扫描及85455张标准化多视角渲染图，评估多模态大模型分层推理。
key_points: 覆盖从牙弓到牙面分层的龋齿定位与分级评估
含5,932例3D口内扫描、85,455张多视角渲染图

abstract: Dental caries assessment is a structured clinical process requiring lesion localization, identification of the affected tooth and surface, and severity grading rather than simple image-level recognition. 3D intraoral scans (IOS) preserve detailed dental geometry and surface morphology and support standardized rendering from complementary viewpoints, enabling fine-grained visual assessment while introducing a distinct need for anatomically grounded multi-view reasoning. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and dental vision-language benchmarks, existing evaluations do not jointly assess hierarchical arch-to-tooth-to-surface reasoning, cross-view evidence integration, and surface-level caries assessment. To address this gap, we introduce CariesBench, a hierarchical benchmark constructed from 5,932 3D IOS, comprising 85,455 standardized multi-view renderings and 133,994 clinically grounded visual question answering instances with expert quality control. CariesBench comprises three complementary task families: Arch-level Clinical Screening (ACS), Tooth-level Diagnostic Reasoning (TDR), and Structured Clinical Decision-Making (SCD). Using the CariesBench training set, we further fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to obtain IntraoralGPT. Extensive evaluation of 24 representative baseline MLLMs reveals a substantial benchmark-level performance disparity between arch-level screening and tooth-level diagnostic reasoning, with higher accuracy on ACS than on TDR. CariesBench-specific supervision substantially improves the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, increasing the 19-task macro-average clinical accuracy from 52.7% to 69.5% and TDR Overall from 34.4% to 44.7%.

abstract: [Journal of personalized medicine] Heart failure affects more than 64 million people worldwide and remains associated with high mortality and recurrent hospitalisation. Artificial intelligence (AI), including large language models (LLMs), is being evaluated across the care pathway, but evidence maturity varies by task. The aim of this narrative review was to appraise direct evidence for LLM applications in heart failure, distinguish it from supporting evidence for other AI methods and propose a risk-based framework for clinical evaluation and governance. The strongest direct LLM evidence concerns electronic health record extraction, document drafting, patient information and clinical trial endpoint adjudication. A small, randomised pilot evaluated supervised generative-AI-guided optimisation of guideline-directed medical therapy. Prospective case-finding and monitoring evidence largely concerns non-LLM AI. For conversational AI telemonitoring (a natural language interface with rule-based alerting), prospective evidence was limited to a single non-randomised controlled pilot. Performance depends on task definition, data completeness, human review and workflow adoption. Overall, LLMs can support clearly defined, supervised heart failure tasks, but current evidence does not justify autonomous high-stakes care. The evidence base is expanding but predominantly retrospective. Prospective trials, disease-specific benchmarks, equity assessment and regulatory engagement are prerequisites for safe clinical translation. Human oversight remains essential across all current-generation applications.

abstract: [Clinical imaging] Data drift refers to changes in the distribution or characteristics of input data after deployment that may adversely affect the performance of artificial intelligence (AI) systems, even when the software continues to function exactly as designed. Patient demographics, disease prevalence, referral patterns, imaging protocols and technology continue to evolve after deployment, resulting in a divergence between the data distribution a model was trained on and the distribution it encounters in practice, without any discrete coding error or malfunction. These technical realities raise distinctive medicolegal questions when a patient is harmed by a degraded model. Establishing negligence centers on whether an ongoing institutional duty exists to monitor for performance deterioration, how breach can be proved absent consensus benchmarks for surveillance frequency and how causation can be demonstrated where AI output is only one element of clinical decision-making and its reasoning may be an opaque "black box" to its users. Comparative fault principles may allocate responsibility according to relative control and knowledge among institutions, vendors and radiologists. Products liability exposure and federal preemption laws also play a role. Risk reduction measures include lifecycle documentation, risk proportionate surveillance, auditability of algorithms and outputs, contractual allocation of monitoring responsibility, and sustained clinician oversight. Radiologists and institutions should anticipate a standard of care that evolves well before controlling case law develops.
zh_abstract: [Clinical imaging] 数据漂移（Data drift）是指部署后输入数据的分布或特征发生变化，可能对人工智能（AI）系统的性能产生不利影响，即使软件仍完全按设计运行。患者人口统计学特征、疾病患病率、转诊模式、影像检查方案和技术在部署后持续演变，导致模型训练时所依据的数据分布与其在实践中遇到的分布之间出现差异，而没有任何离散的编码错误或故障。当患者因性能退化的模型受到伤害时，这些技术现实提出了独特的医疗法律问题。确立过失的核心在于：是否存在持续性的机构义务来监测性能恶化；在缺乏关于监测频率的共识基准时，如何证明违反义务；以及在 AI 输出只是临床决策的一个要素、且其推理对使用者可能是不透明“黑箱”的情况下，如何证明因果关系。比较过失原则可能根据机构、供应商和放射科医生之间的相对控制力和知识来分配责任。产品责任风险暴露和联邦优先适用（preemption）法律也发挥作用。降低风险的措施包括生命周期文档记录、与风险相称的监测、算法和输出的可审计性、监测责任的合同分配，以及持续的临床医生监督。放射科医生和机构应预期，诊疗标准会在具有约束力的判例法形成之前很久就已演变。

abstract: [Journal of the American Dental Association (1939)] Precision oral health requires clinicians to consider patient-specific clinical, biological, behavioral, imaging, and preference sensitive data when making clinical decisions. In routine oral health care, however, these data are often fragmented across electronic dental records, imaging platforms, diagnostic tests, narrative notes, and patient-generated sources. Clinical decision support (CDS) systems provide a mechanism for organizing these data and translating them into timely, evidence-informed recommendations at the point of care. A narrative review was conducted of peer-reviewed literature relevant to precision dentistry, CDS, dental informatics, artificial intelligence, biomarkers and omics technologies, and patient-generated health data. Priority was given to dental studies, which were supplemented by broader medical CDS literature when dental-specific evidence was limited. CDS systems can function as digital infrastructure and generate clinical recommendations based on patient-specific data using evidence-based knowledge and predictive analytics. In dentistry, CDS applications range from rule-based reminders and electronic quality measures to artificial intelligence-assisted radiographic interpretation, risk prediction, biomarker screening, and emerging multimodal platforms. The clinical readiness of these technologies varies substantially, and their value depends on data quality, validation, work flow integration, usability, interoperability, privacy safeguards, and clinician oversight. CDS systems can assist clinicians by offering evidence-based, personalized recommendations that synthesize pertinent and available information. These systems are crucial for practicing precision dentistry. Although efforts to enhance the adoption, usability, effectiveness, and acceptance of CDS systems continue, clinicians should always regard CDS systems as tools and retain full responsibility for their decisions and involve patients in the decision-making process.

abstract: [Canadian family physician Medecin de famille canadien] To provide family physicians with a practical overview of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in primary care practice and their potential to address burnout, improve workflow, support clinical decision making, and enhance patient care. A comprehensive narrative review of AI tools in primary care was conducted using peer-reviewed literature from PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar, with subject headings artificial intelligence and primary care, along with related terms. Relevant real-world pilot projects and case studies were hand-searched to identify those not captured through database searches. Canadian family physicians are facing rising levels of burnout, driven by overwhelming administrative demands and increasing patient complexity. With 1 in 4 Ontarians estimated to be without a family doctor in 2026, primary care is under considerable strain. AI tools-particularly those powered by natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs)-offer timely, practical solutions across 4 domains: ambient AI scribes to reduce documentation time and enhance patient-physician interaction; intelligent document processing and clinical summarization to streamline inbox management and information retrieval; clinical evidence synthesis LLMs to summarize medical evidence at the point of care; and AI clinical decision support systems to improve diagnosis and disease management. Real-world implementation in primary care demonstrates these tools can improve workflow efficiency, reduce time spent on paperwork, enhance adherence to clinical guidelines, and improve patient satisfaction. However, inaccuracies in AI-generated content, model bias, lack of transparency, and data privacy risks all require careful oversight. AI and NLP applications have potential to be timely tools that reduce strain and restore capacity for relational, person-centred care. Thoughtful adoption-guided by evidence-informed deployment, user-centred design, and regulatory safeguards-will be essential to ensure safe, equitable integration into primary care practice.

abstract: [Talanta] Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) is a systems-level thermodynamic tool for probing disease-related changes in complex biological fluids, yet clinical translation is hindered by challenges in thermogram interpretation, reproducibility, and data integration. DSC captures heat capacity transitions from multistate protein unfolding, reflecting collective stability landscapes of the plasma proteome. Pathological conditions can induce reproducible thermogram distortions, suggesting their utility as ensemble biomarkers beyond conventional scalar descriptors. Recent advances in ultrasensitive and microfluidic DSC have improved stability and reduced sample needs, while artificial intelligence enables extraction of distributed calorimetric features beyond melting temperature and enthalpy. Machine learning strategies-including statistical, kernel-based, deep learning, and physics-informed frameworks-help identify informative thermodynamic patterns. This review integrates thermodynamic principles, data-driven analytics, and clinical studies to assess DSC's capabilities and limitations. We further propose practical standardization and minimum-reporting frameworks for DSC acquisition, preprocessing, AI model development, and validation to improve reproducibility and cross-study comparability. Persistent issues such as inter-laboratory variability, cohort heterogeneity, small datasets, and regulatory hurdles continue to restrict routine use. Overall, combining DSC with AI offers a promising analytical framework for extracting clinically meaningful thermodynamic insights and advancing disease characterization.

abstract: [Journal of neural engineering] Deep learning models have been widely applied to predict major depressive disorder (MDD) using magnetoencephalography (MEG) signals. However, these models often suffer from limited performance and generalization. This is primarily due to the strong individual heterogeneity inherent in MEG temporal signals, which makes it difficult for models trained on small samples to distinguish disease-related features and individual-specific features. To address this issue, we propose GRLV, a plug-and-play framework based on gradient reversal layer with variance loss, that can be readily embedded into existing deep learning classification models. This framework introduces a variance loss function to the gradient reversal layer (GRL) framework to compensate for its convergence limitations. We evaluated GRLV on 10 backbone models, achieving an average classification accuracy of 68.2%, and surpassing baseline models by 3.5%. Visualization results prove that the GRLV framework effectively attends to bilateral occipital activities within the first 100 ms post stimulus on-set, which is associated with the early processing of negative emotional faces in MDD patients, and is a better disease marker due to less contamination from individual heterogeneity. These findings fully demonstrate the broad application potential of GRLV in existing MEG/EEG decoding models and the discovery of mental diseases. These findings fully demonstrate the broad applicability of GRLV on existing MEG/EEG decoding models and its potential for advancing the discovery of biomarkers of mental disorders.
zh_abstract: [Journal of neural engineering] 深度学习模型已被广泛应用于利用脑磁图（magnetoencephalography, MEG）信号预测重度抑郁症（major depressive disorder, MDD）。然而，这些模型常受限于性能和泛化能力。这主要是由于 MEG 时间信号中固有的强个体异质性，使得在小样本上训练的模型难以区分疾病相关特征和个体特异性特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出 GRLV，一个基于梯度反转层并带有方差损失的即插即用框架，可方便地嵌入现有深度学习分类模型。该框架在梯度反转层（gradient reversal layer, GRL）框架中引入方差损失函数，以补偿其收敛性限制。我们在 10 个骨干模型上评估 GRLV，取得平均分类准确率 68.2%，超过基线模型 3.5%。可视化结果证明，GRLV 框架有效关注刺激开始后前 100 ms 内的双侧枕区活动，这与 MDD 患者对负性情绪面孔的早期加工相关，并且由于受个体异质性污染较少而成为更好的疾病标志物。这些发现充分展示了 GRLV 在现有 MEG/EEG 解码模型中的广泛应用潜力，以及在精神疾病发现中的潜力。这些发现充分展示了 GRLV 在现有 MEG/EEG 解码模型上的广泛适用性，以及其推进精神障碍生物标志物发现的潜力。

title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
zh_title: 特权在线蒸馏用于缺失模态AD诊断
summary: 预印本提出特权在线蒸馏方法，在模态缺失下进行校准的阿尔茨海默病诊断。
key_points: 模型自行填补缺失的模态数据

abstract: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病根据临床、生物样本和影像学证据进行诊断，但很少有患者接受每一项检查。由于这些模态互为补充，缺失某一模态时会有许多合理取值。大多数现有方法将其省略或基于单一估计进行训练，因此其分类器从未见到该模态的其他取值，而且该估计从未对照诊断进行校验。我们通过同策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）解决这两个缺口：模型自行填补缺失模态，而仅在训练中可获得信息的教师对这些填补进行评分。我们的方法——带评分展开填补与特权教师（Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers）——每次抽取一个模态，进行多次填补。了解诊断信息的填补教师对每一步评分，按照统计学实践的建议将结局纳入填补过程。可看到所有真实模态的诊断教师提供软目标。由于在变化多样的填补上进行训练，模型学习到一种反映缺失检查所遗留不确定性的置信度，并可基于单次展开进行诊断。在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative）队列上，它优于最先进的基线。在两个外部队列上，其判别能力仍具竞争力，而且即使在对每种方法重新校准后，其校准误差在两个队列上均与最低者相当。将这些教师加入其中三个基线后，每个基线均得到改善。我们的方法为患者已接受的任意检查组合提供单一且校准良好的模型。

title: Automated Batch-Variable Selection for ComBat-Based Radiomic Harmonization

abstract: ComBat harmonizes multicentre radiomic features, but batch variables are usually chosen manually, without a standardized criterion across image acquisition parameters. We propose ParsiComBat, which selects acquisition parameters for ComBat, balancing batch-effect removal against feature-structure preservation and abstaining when technical variation is negligible. ParsiComBat ranks candidate acquisition parameters by batch effect, filters redundancy, and scores sequential ComBat corrections. We evaluated it in three experiments: in simulations, testing whether it recovered a known batch variable and abstained without one; in CT (NSCLC-Radiomics) and MRI (MAMA-MIA) cohorts, comparing batch-effect removal against manufacturer (manual), every feasible parameter (greedy) and AutoCombat; and in clinical prediction, internally and externally. In simulations, ParsiComBat identified the true batch variable in 92.9% of positive trials and abstained in 99.2% of null controls. In CT, correcting for reconstruction kernel reduced mean k-nearest neighbour batch-effect test from 0.276 to 0.032, almost matching greedy correction of six variables. In MRI, correcting for slice thickness and manufacturer reduced it from 0.680 to 0.325, slightly more than manual selection but less than greedy correction of seven variables. Removing technical variation did not improve clinical discrimination: no strategy, including raw features, differed significantly from ParsiComBat in area under the curve. ParsiComBat provides a data-driven framework that removes technical batch effects using minimal acquisition parameters, preserving feature structure and clinical discrimination. It selects variables verifiable against the acquisition protocol and abstains when no correction is needed, supporting transparent, reproducible multicentre radiomics.
zh_abstract: ComBat 可协调多中心放射组学特征，但批次变量通常为手动选择，缺乏跨图像采集参数的标准化标准。我们提出 ParsiComBat，它为 ComBat 选择采集参数，在去除批次效应与保持特征结构之间取得平衡，并在技术变异可忽略时不进行校正（弃权）。ParsiComBat 按批次效应对候选采集参数排序，过滤冗余，并对序贯 ComBat 校正进行评分。我们在三项实验中评估了它：在模拟中，测试其是否恢复已知批次变量并在无批次变量时弃权；在 CT（NSCLC-Radiomics）和 MRI（MAMA-MIA）队列中，将批次效应去除与制造商（手动）、每个可行参数（贪心）和 AutoCombat 进行比较；以及在内部和外部进行临床预测。在模拟中，ParsiComBat 在 92.9% 的阳性试验中识别出真实批次变量，并在 99.2% 的零对照中弃权。在 CT 中，校正重建核使平均 k 近邻批次效应检验从 0.276 降至 0.032，几乎匹配对六个变量进行贪心校正。在 MRI 中，校正层厚和制造商将其从 0.680 降至 0.325，略大于手动选择，但小于对七个变量进行贪心校正。去除技术变异并未改善临床判别：包括原始特征在内的任何策略在曲线下面积上均与 ParsiComBat 无显著差异。ParsiComBat 提供了一个数据驱动框架，使用最少的采集参数去除技术批次效应，保持特征结构和临床判别。它选择可对照采集方案验证的变量，并在无需校正时弃权，支持透明、可重复的多中心放射组学。

abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] Multidisciplinary tumor boards (MDTs) guide prostate cancer decisions but are strained by rising case volumes, evolving guidelines, and growing complexity. Artificial intelligence (AI) now enters the MDT at two levels. First, it generates inputs: deep-learning magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reading matches or exceeds radiologists' performance in the Prostate Imaging-Cancer Artificial Intelligence (PI-CAI) study; Gleason grading reaches expert-level agreement; PSMA PET quantification is automated; and multimodal pathology biomarkers predict ADT benefit. Second, decision-support systems act on MDT output: rule-based tools reproduce standard recommendations in 86-99% of cases, mostly in populations dominated by standard cases, whereas general-purpose large language models (LLMs) agree with real urological boards in 56-93% of cases, depending largely on input quality and case mix, and perform worse in metastatic disease; agreement does not establish clinical benefit. Of 33 appraised decision-support studies, 27 were at high risk of bias, 20 of them solely because the treating board served as an unblinded reference standard; explainability, regulation, and automation bias remain unresolved. We propose that AI currently serves as a supervised pre-reader, guideline checker, and triage tool. Prospective multicenter studies with patient outcomes are needed.
zh_abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] 多学科肿瘤委员会（MDTs）指导前列腺癌决策，但正因病例量上升、指南不断演变和复杂性增加而承受压力。人工智能（AI）现在在两个层面进入MDT。首先，它生成输入：在前列腺影像-癌症人工智能（PI-CAI）研究中，深度学习磁共振成像（MRI）阅片达到或超过放射科医师的表现；Gleason分级达到专家级一致性；PSMA PET定量实现自动化；多模态病理生物标志物可预测ADT获益。其次，决策支持系统作用于MDT输出：基于规则的工具在86-99%的病例中重现标准建议，主要是在以标准病例为主的人群中；而通用大型语言模型（LLMs）在56-93%的病例中与真实泌尿外科委员会一致，这在很大程度上取决于输入质量和病例构成，并且在转移性疾病中表现更差；一致性并不能确立临床获益。在33项被评价的决策支持研究中，27项存在高偏倚风险，其中20项仅因治疗委员会作为非盲参考标准；可解释性、监管和自动化偏倚仍未解决。我们提出，AI目前作为有监督的预读者、指南检查器和分诊工具。需要开展以患者结局为终点的前瞻性多中心研究。

abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) regulate complex pathophysiological networks and represent a critical class of drug targets, but their structural determination and ligand screening are constrained by dependence on homology templates, static conformations, and a bias toward known ligands. Artificial intelligence is fundamentally transforming GPCR structural biology and pharmacology by overcoming these bottlenecks. The methodologies encompass high-precision static structure prediction, dynamic conformational ensemble modeling, ultra-large-scale virtual screening, de novo ligand design, allosteric mechanism decoding, biased signaling quantification, and systems pharmacology. Deep learning architectures enable end-to-end structure prediction exemplified by AlphaFold series, billion-compound virtual screening and unbiased de novo ligand design via diffusion models. Three-dimensional structure-aware Graph neural networks and molecular dynamics simulations are shifting research focus from single static conformations to transient conformations, cryptic allosteric sites, and ligand-induced biased signaling. Systems-level investigation through multi-omics-integrated GPCR digital twins advances personalized precision medicine. This review summarizes the innovative AI-driven paradigm, breaking traditional restrictions and greatly improving structural resolution of orphan receptors and GPCR complexes, thereby offering a comprehensive reference for dynamic GPCR pharmacological research. Core challenges include the black-box nature of deep learning, structural distribution biases, and the translational gap, which can be addressed by physics-informed models and high-throughput validation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）调控复杂的病理生理网络，是一类关键药物靶点，但其结构解析和配体筛选受到对同源模板、静态构象的依赖以及对已知配体偏倚的制约。人工智能通过克服这些瓶颈，正在从根本上改变GPCR结构生物学和药理学。这些方法涵盖高精度静态结构预测、动态构象集合建模、超大规模虚拟筛选、从头配体设计、变构机制解析、偏向性信号定量以及系统药理学。深度学习架构支持端到端结构预测（以AlphaFold系列为代表）、十亿化合物级虚拟筛选以及通过扩散模型进行的无偏从头配体设计。三维结构感知图神经网络和分子动力学模拟正在将研究重点从单一静态构象转向瞬态构象、隐蔽变构位点和配体诱导的偏向性信号。通过多组学整合的GPCR数字孪生进行的系统级研究推动了个性化精准医学。本综述总结了创新的AI驱动范式，该范式打破传统限制，并极大提高了孤儿受体和GPCR复合物的结构分辨率，从而为动态GPCR药理学研究提供全面参考。核心挑战包括深度学习的黑箱性质、结构分布偏倚和转化鸿沟，这些可通过物理知情模型和高通量验证加以应对。

title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
