abstract: Objective: To develop and validate InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular electronic health records (EHRs) and longitudinal trajectories for scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models. Methods: An optional large language model (LLM) parser converts clinical requests into structured constraints. Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records, while diffusion models generate longitudinal trajectories. We evaluate parsing, distributional fidelity, imputation, clinical-constraint adherence, mortality prediction, and clinical plausibility using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 patients receiving venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO). Results: Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the highest parsing performance with a low spurious slot rate. IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE perform well in single-time-point generation; IGE-CSDI, IGE-FGTI, and IGE-MTSCI lead on different longitudinal fidelity metrics. Across five random seeds and three classifiers, synthetic cohorts retain predictive utility for mortality prediction on real test data. Clinician ratings support trajectory plausibility and alignment with requested scenarios. Conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$ supports clinician-specified generation of EHR trajectories with statistical fidelity and downstream predictive utility in the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort. Extension to other clinical settings requires further validation. Significance: The framework supports scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并验证 InterGenEHR$^+$，这是一个交互式框架，用于以自然语言为条件生成合成表格型电子健康记录（EHRs）和纵向轨迹，以支持基于场景的机器学习模型评估。【方法】一个可选的大语言模型（LLM）解析器将临床请求转换为结构化约束。条件变分自编码器和扩散模型生成单时间点记录，而扩散模型生成纵向轨迹。我们使用一个多机构队列评估解析、分布保真度、插补、临床约束依从性、死亡预测和临床合理性，该队列包含 874 例接受静脉-静脉体外膜肺氧合（VV-ECMO）的患者。【结果】采用少样本提示的 Gemma 3 4B 取得最高解析性能，且虚假槽位率低。IGE-TabDDPM 和 IGE-PMVAE 在单时间点生成中表现良好；IGE-CSDI、IGE-FGTI 和 IGE-MTSCI 在不同纵向保真度指标上领先。在五个随机种子和三个分类器下，合成队列在真实测试数据上仍保留用于死亡预测的预测效用。临床医生评分支持轨迹合理性以及与所请求场景的一致性。【结论】InterGenEHR$^+$ 支持由临床医生指定生成 EHR 轨迹，并在所评估的 VV-ECMO 队列中具有统计保真度和下游预测效用。推广到其他临床环境需要进一步验证。【意义】该框架支持在数据稀疏的重症监护环境中对机器学习模型进行基于场景的评估。

title: An Explainable Analytics Framework for Identifying Process Deviations in Emergency Care for Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions
zh_title: 急诊多病共存患者流程偏差的可解释分析框架
summary: 基于苏格兰 2017–2023 年急诊常规数据，结合一致性检查与可解释机器学习量化多病共存患者的急诊流程偏差。
key_points: 提出偏差评分 DS，兼顾结构与四小时达标
MLTC 患者路径更长更复杂、DS 更高
用常规数据构建经验基准路径
reason: 方法有新意的预印本、有对照比较，但无外部验证与结局证据，属值得一看档。
abstract: Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions (MLTCs), also known as multimorbidity, often present clinical and operational challenges in emergency departments (EDs), yet how their care pathways deviate from expected workflows remains underexplored. This study introduces a process-aware analytical framework that quantifies and interprets ED process deviations by integrating multi-perspective conformance checking with explainable machine learning. Using routinely collected Scottish ED data between 2017-2023, we derived an empirical benchmark pathway. We introduced a new metric, the deviation score (DS), which captures both structural misalignments and breaches of the four-hour ED standard, a national service target defined as completion of ED care within four hours of arrival. Compared with non-MLTC attendances, MLTC patients exhibited longer and more complex pathways, higher DS values, and lower conformance to the benchmark model. The framework enabled interpretable SHAP analyses, revealing that deviation severity among MLTC attendances was primarily associated with triage acuity, year of attendance, activity queue length (number of patients queuing for the same care activity), and referral source, with additional contributions from age, arrival time, and number of chronic conditions. Threshold effects were observed in both queue length and multimorbidity burden, beyond which deviation severity increased sharply, suggesting points where standard pathways become harder to maintain. These findings show that deviation severity for MLTC patients is shaped by clinical urgency and system-level pressures at presentation. However, the inherent complexity of MLTC patients may further increase vulnerability to deviation. The framework offers the potential foundation for process evaluation and targeted improvement in emergency care.
zh_abstract: 多种长期疾病（MLTCs）患者，也称为多病共存患者，常在急诊科（EDs）带来临床和运营挑战，但其诊疗路径如何偏离预期工作流程仍未得到充分探索。本研究引入一个过程感知分析框架，通过将多视角一致性检查与可解释机器学习相结合，量化并解释急诊科过程偏差。使用 2017-2023 年间常规收集的苏格兰急诊科数据，我们推导出一条经验基准路径。我们引入一个新指标——偏差评分（DS），该指标同时捕捉结构性错配和违反急诊四小时标准的情况；该标准是一项国家服务目标，定义为在到达后四小时内完成急诊诊疗。与非 MLTC 就诊相比，MLTC 患者表现出更长、更复杂的路径、更高的 DS 值以及与基准模型更低的一致性。该框架支持可解释的 SHAP 分析，揭示 MLTC 就诊中的偏差严重程度主要与分诊病情严重程度、就诊年份、活动队列长度（排队等待同一诊疗活动的患者数）和转诊来源相关，年龄、到达时间和慢性病数量也有额外贡献。在队列长度和多病共存负担中均观察到阈值效应，超过阈值后偏差严重程度急剧增加，提示标准路径变得更难维持的临界点。这些发现表明，MLTC 患者的偏差严重程度由就诊时的临床紧急性和系统层面压力所塑造。然而，MLTC 患者固有的复杂性可能进一步增加其对偏差的易感性。该框架为急诊诊疗中的过程评价和针对性改进提供了潜在基础。

title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
zh_title: 面向日本场景的HealthBench本地化基准JHealthBench-L
summary: 该预印本通过大模型起草、专科医生筛选与双医师独立复核，将HealthBench改编为日本本地化评测集，含79例咨询、1022条评分标准。
key_points: 79例患者咨询、1022条评分标准
独立双医师复核通过率93.6%
仅4.4%标准需完全重写
reason: 这是新构建的经医生复核的本地化评测基准，但规模较小且为预印本，因此属于值得一看档
abstract: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($τ= 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L.
zh_abstract: 诸如HealthBench等基于评分细则的基准使用病例特异性医师标准对开放式健康咨询中的大语言模型（LLMs）进行评估，其中许多标准预设了其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和诊疗路径。仅在机器翻译下，这些地区性假设仍保留在评分细则中，使得在日本合适的回答未被计分，或根据外国临床规则被错误扣分。为了在不从头编写评分细则的情况下将既有的临床评估视角适配到日本，我们通过有来源引用的LLM起草、单一专科医生筛选与修订、独立双医师审核以及元审核，构建了JHealthBench-L（79个面向患者的咨询，1,022条标准）。专科医生仅从头改写了4.4%的标准，独立审核者无异议批准了93.6%的第二阶段标准。在18个LLM上比较JHealthBench-L与机器翻译基线显示，仅翻译评估保留了粗粒度模型排名（τ= 0.817，平均偏移 +0.027），但翻转了17.7%的修改标准的判定（对比7.3%的重新评分噪声），并将日本适配的负向标准上的错误扣分减少了7.1个百分点，从而在稳定的排行榜背后掩盖了条目层面的临床测量错误。轴级和配对分析进一步显示，上下文意识和日本特异性临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日语持续预训练和推理后训练显著改善了本地情境下的表现。数据集、医师修订日志和评估代码可在 https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L 获取。

title: XenoType: Decoding cellular identity in breast cancer histology through molecular supervision
zh_title: XenoType：用分子监督从乳腺癌组织学解码细胞身份
summary: 提出XenoType框架，借助同切片空间分子测量监督，从常规H&E图像将细胞分为七类分子定义类别。
key_points: 用同切片配对数据监督，无需另切组织
直接从常规H&E图像分类七种分子定义细胞类别
旨在减少依赖人工标注与聚类主观选择
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但条目未见基线对比与开源信息，属值得一看档
abstract: Characterizing the cellular composition of the tumor microenvironment from histological images is fundamental to understanding cancer biology and informing treatment decisions. Deep learning has enabled automated nuclear detection and classification from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images, yet cell classifiers remain largely confined to broad morphological categories owing to a reliance on manual annotations. Recent efforts have used spatial molecular measurements to supervise histological classification, but these approaches often require separate tissue sections or produce altered H&E staining, and the resulting cell-type annotations depend on subjective choices such as marker selection and clustering parameters. Here we develop XenoType, a framework that classifies cells into seven molecularly informed categories directly from routine histology, trained using paired same-section Xenium spatial transcriptomics. Cell-type annotations are reconciled from four single-cell RNA-sequencing references, reducing dependence on marker choices. Across eight held-out breast tissue sections, XenoType outperformed commonly used CellViT++ retrained on the same molecular annotations under both four-class (macro-F1: 0.703 vs. 0.569) and seven-class (macro-F1: 0.571 vs. 0.403) taxonomies, with the largest gains for myoepithelial (F1: 0.175 to 0.572) and endothelial cells (F1: 0.395 to 0.682). Molecular measurements are required only during training; at inference, XenoType uses the H&E image alone. Model-reference agreement increased consistently with annotation confidence, and XenoType generalized to an independently profiled breast tissue section from a different spatial transcriptomics platform, supporting scalable cell-type mapping from routine histology without per-specimen molecular profiling.
zh_abstract: 从组织学图像表征肿瘤微环境的细胞组成，对于理解癌症生物学和指导治疗决策至关重要。深度学习已能够从苏木精-伊红（H&E）图像中实现自动细胞核检测和分类，然而，由于依赖人工标注，细胞分类器在很大程度上仍局限于宽泛的形态学类别。近期研究利用空间分子测量来监督组织学分类，但这些方法通常需要单独的组织切片或产生改变的H&E染色，且所得细胞类型注释依赖于标志物选择和聚类参数等主观选择。在此，我们开发了XenoType，一个可直接从常规组织学将细胞分类为七种分子信息指导类别的框架，使用配对的同切片Xenium空间转录组学进行训练。细胞类型注释从四个单细胞RNA测序参考中协调统一，减少了对标志物选择的依赖。在八个留出的乳腺组织切片中，XenoType在四分类（宏平均F1（macro-F1）：0.703 vs. 0.569）和七分类（宏平均F1（macro-F1）：0.571 vs. 0.403）分类体系下均优于在同一分子注释上重新训练的常用CellViT++，其中肌上皮细胞（F1：0.175至0.572）和内皮细胞（F1：0.395至0.682）的增益最大。分子测量仅在训练期间需要；在推理时，XenoType仅使用H&E图像。模型-参考一致性随注释置信度持续增加，且XenoType可泛化至来自不同空间转录组学平台的独立分析乳腺组织切片，支持从常规组织学进行可扩展的细胞类型映射，而无需对每个标本进行分子分析。

title: SYNDRI: Context-aware removal of transcript spillover in imaging-based spatial transcriptomics
zh_title: SYNDRI：空间转录组转录本溢出校正方法
summary: 预印本提出基于transformer的基因级分类方法，校正空间转录组转录本溢出。
key_points: 将溢出检测建模为有监督基因级分类
用模拟数据SYNDRI-SIM生成训练标签
针对分割误差导致的邻细胞转录本错配
reason: 有新方法的预印本，基于模拟基准，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression at single-cell resolution, but imperfect segmentation often misassigns transcripts between neighboring cells, a problem known as transcript spillover. This spillover is niche-dependent and can therefore confound downstream analyses that rely on niche-specific differential expression. True spillover cannot be directly quantified in experimental ST data, so existing correction methods infer contamination indirectly from transcript positions or expression structure. Here we introduce SYNDRI, a post-segmentation correction method that frames spillover detection as a supervised, gene-level classification task. We develop SYNDRI-SIM to generate labeled training data by simulating spillover between spatially mapped scRNA-seq profiles. SYNDRI uses a transformer to predict gene-level spillover probabilities conditioned on each cell's expression, identity, and local neighborhood, without requiring transcript-level coordinates or deconvolution. On held-out simulated data, SYNDRI achieves an AUPRC of 0.86, compared with 0.64 for the next-best method. Across MERFISH, CosMx, and Xenium datasets, SYNDRI achieves the highest aggregate performance across metrics of cell-type separation, reference similarity, and preservation of within-cell-type heterogeneity. In a CosMx lung cancer dataset, SYNDRI removes nearly all potentially contaminating tumor and macrophage markers from differential expression between tumor-associated and stromal fibroblasts while retaining native fibroblast markers. These results demonstrate the utility of learning from simulated spillover to improve the interpretation of spatial gene expression.
zh_abstract: 基于成像的空间转录组学（ST）在单细胞分辨率下测量基因表达，但不完美的分割常会在相邻细胞之间错误分配转录本，这一问题被称为转录本溢出（transcript spillover）。这种溢出具有生态位依赖性，因此可能混淆依赖生态位特异性差异表达的下游分析。真实溢出无法在实验ST数据中直接量化，因此现有校正方法从转录本位置或表达结构间接推断污染。在此，我们介绍SYNDRI，一种分割后校正方法，将溢出的检测构建为有监督的基因水平分类任务。我们开发SYNDRI-SIM，通过模拟空间映射的scRNA-seq谱之间的溢出来生成带标签的训练数据。SYNDRI使用Transformer，以每个细胞的表达、身份和局部邻域为条件预测基因水平溢出概率，无需转录本水平坐标或反卷积。在留出的模拟数据上，SYNDRI达到0.86的AUPRC，而次优方法为0.64。在MERFISH、CosMx和Xenium数据集中，SYNDRI在细胞类型分离、参考相似性和细胞类型内异质性保留等指标上取得最高总体性能。在一个CosMx肺癌数据集中，SYNDRI从肿瘤相关成纤维细胞与基质成纤维细胞之间的差异表达中移除了几乎所有可能污染的肿瘤和巨噬细胞标志物，同时保留了原生成纤维细胞标志物。这些结果表明，从模拟溢出中学习有助于改善空间基因表达的解释。

title: RadOncGym: An Agent-Based Framework for Radiotherapy Dose-Mimicking Optimization
zh_title: RadOncGym：智能体框架优化放疗剂量模仿
summary: 预印本提出RadOncGym，用LLM智能体迭代调整放疗计划目标权重以优化剂量模仿。
key_points: LLM智能体调整12项放疗目标权重
代理验证器降低迭代求解成本
在60例头颈患者600个预测上评估
reason: 预印本新方法，公开数据评估但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy, providing an important intermediate representation for automated radiotherapy planning. However, an AI-predicted dose must undergo downstream optimization to produce a physically constrained treatment plan, a process that requires balancing competing planning objectives. We present RadOncGym, an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for dose-mimicking optimization. To reduce iterative evaluation cost, RadOncGym incorporates a surrogate verifier that provides rapid feedback while allowing the agent to decide when to request a full planning solve within a fixed solve budget. We evaluate RadOncGym on 60 OpenKBP head-and-neck patients, each paired with 10 predictions from OpenKBP-Opt dose-prediction sets, yielding 600 patient-prediction contexts per experimental configuration. Under RadOncGym's 16-turn setting with a three-solve budget, a GPT-5.6 Sol agent reduces mean clinical-criterion violation by 0.6131 Gy and improves DVH and dose scores by 0.5986 and 0.2204 Gy relative to leaving all 12 weights fixed at 1, outperforming all evaluated non-agent weight-tuning methods under the same solve budget. It remains competitive with the 16-solve variants of these methods while requiring 75.0-77.6% less normalized runtime. RadOncGym demonstrates the potential of LLM agents as optimization planners in downstream radiotherapy plan optimization and provides a public testbed for their systematic evaluation. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym.
zh_abstract: AI 剂量预测模型根据患者解剖结构生成患者特异性三维剂量分布，为自动化放疗计划提供重要的中间表示。然而，AI 预测的剂量必须经过下游优化才能生成物理约束下的治疗计划，这一过程需要平衡相互冲突的计划目标。我们提出 RadOncGym，这是一个基于智能体的框架，使 LLM 智能体能够迭代调整 12 个计划目标权重，用于剂量模仿优化。为降低迭代评估成本，RadOncGym 引入代理验证器（surrogate verifier），可提供快速反馈，同时允许智能体在固定的求解预算内决定何时请求完整计划求解。我们在 60 例 OpenKBP 头颈患者上评估 RadOncGym，每例患者配以来自 OpenKBP-Opt 剂量预测集的 10 个预测，每个实验配置共产生 600 个患者-预测上下文。在 RadOncGym 的 16 轮设置和三次求解预算下，GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体相对于将全部 12 个权重固定为 1，将平均临床标准违反度降低 0.6131 Gy，并将 DVH 得分和剂量得分分别提高 0.5986 Gy 和 0.2204 Gy，在相同求解预算下优于所有已评估的非智能体权重调整方法。它与这些方法的 16 次求解变体相比仍具竞争力，同时所需归一化运行时间减少 75.0-77.6%。RadOncGym 展示了 LLM 智能体作为下游放疗计划优化中优化规划器的潜力，并为其系统评估提供了公共测试平台。代码和配置见 https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym。

title: GASTON-VI efficiently quantifies spatial axes and molecular gradients from multi-sample, multi-modal spatial-omics data
zh_title: GASTON-VI量化空间组学空间轴与分子梯度
summary: 预印本提出GASTON-VI，用变分推断深度学习从多样本多模态空间组学数据量化空间轴与分子梯度。
key_points: 面向多切片多模态空间组学数据
用变分推断建模空间轴与分子梯度
突破仅限小规模单切片的方法限制
reason: 预印本方法创新，生物医学基础研究，证据限于计算评估，属值得一看档。
abstract: Many tissues exhibit an underlying spatial axis along which fundamental biological processes occur due to continuous spatial gradients of cell type and molecular state. Modern spatial-omics technologies measure molecular features (e.g. gene/protein expression) at 100,000s-1,000,000s of locations within a two-dimensional (2-D) tissue slice, with large-scale atlases profiling multiple tissue slices of the same organ type across different individuals and biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). However, existing computational methods for identifying spatial molecular gradients are limited to small spatial transcriptomics datasets (1000s of cells) of a single tissue slice, while methods for integrating multiple samples do not explicitly model spatial axes nor spatial molecular gradients along such axes. Here, we present GASTON-VI, a variational inference (VI)-based deep learning model which efficiently learns an underlying spatial axis and spatial molecular gradients along this axis from multi-sample, multi-condition spatial-omics data of any molecular modality (e.g. transcriptomics, proteomics). GASTON-VI jointly learns (1) a spatial coordinate (the "isodepth") for each individual tissue slice and (2) 1-D spatial modality functions that describe molecular gradients along the isodepth for tissues of the same biological condition, while utilizing a latent variable model to account for batch effects. Further, GASTON-VI implements a statistical test for identifying molecules with differential spatial gradients across biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). On spatial transcriptomics and proteomics data from the intestine, tonsil, and liver, we show that GASTON-VI recovers spatial axes and molecular gradients along these axes more accurately and efficiently than existing methods. In particular, applied to large-scale spatial transcriptomics and proteomics atlases, GASTON-VI reveals differential spatial gradients of gene expression along the portal vein-central vein axis in fibrotic livers, and differential spatial gradients of protein abundance along the muscularis-lumen axis across different regions of the intestine. Software availability: GASTON-VI is available at https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI.
zh_abstract: 许多组织存在一条潜在的空间轴，由于细胞类型和分子状态的连续空间梯度，基本生物学过程沿该轴发生。现代空间组学技术在二维（2-D）组织切片的 100,000 至 1,000,000 量级的位置上测量分子特征（例如基因/蛋白质表达），大规模图谱则对同一器官类型在不同个体和生物学条件（例如健康与疾病）下的多个组织切片进行分析。然而，现有用于识别空间分子梯度的计算方法仅限于单个组织切片的小型空间转录组数据集（数千个细胞），而整合多个样本的方法既未显式建模空间轴，也未显式建模沿此类轴的空间分子梯度。在此，我们提出 GASTON-VI，这是一种基于变分推断（VI）的深度学习模型，可从任意分子模态（例如转录组学、蛋白质组学）的多样本、多条件空间组学数据中高效学习潜在空间轴及沿该轴的空间分子梯度。GASTON-VI 联合学习（1）每个组织切片的空间坐标（“等深度”，isodepth），以及（2）一维空间模态函数，用于描述同一生物学条件组织沿等深度的分子梯度，同时利用潜变量模型考虑批次效应。此外，GASTON-VI 实现了一种统计检验，用于识别在不同生物学条件（例如健康与疾病）之间具有差异空间梯度的分子。在来自肠道、扁桃体和肝脏的空间转录组学和蛋白质组学数据上，我们表明 GASTON-VI 比现有方法更准确、更高效地恢复空间轴及沿这些轴的分子梯度。特别是，应用于大规模空间转录组学和蛋白质组学图谱时，GASTON-VI 揭示了纤维化肝脏中沿门静脉-中央静脉轴基因表达的差异空间梯度，以及肠道不同区域中沿肌层-管腔轴蛋白质丰度的差异空间梯度。软件可用性：GASTON-VI 可在 https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI 获取。

title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
zh_title: EPPC-CARE：患者门户消息沟通行为的分层标注
summary: 基于867条门户消息的5516条标注，提出自动识别沟通行为及其支撑文本的框架，在六个开源大模型上与微调及EPPC-OASIS比较并与专家标注对照。
key_points: 标注为文本片段、类别、子类别的三元组
评测六种开源权重LLM，对比监督微调与EPPC-OASIS
在100条消息上与人类专家标注比较
reason: 有新意的临床NLP标注框架并含人工对照，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved by 2.90 percentage points on average, with a best score of 64.4%. On the human expert evaluation subset, EPPC-CARE and the human expert showed comparable agreement with the reference standard, with differences favoring EPPC-CARE. Discussion: These findings suggest that identifying triplet components (span, code, subcode) sequentially can improve performance across model families while preserving the supporting text behind each identification. EPPC-CARE links the communication code and subcode with the source text (span), supporting human verification of automated annotations in clinical informatics. EPPC-CARE may therefore make larger-scale studies of patient-provider communication more feasible and provide a foundation for human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Conclusion: EPPC-CARE offers a more reliable and reviewable approach for automated characterization of communication behaviors in secure patient-provider messaging.
zh_abstract: 【目的】患者门户消息为患者与医疗服务提供者之间的沟通动态提供了宝贵信息，但人工提取这些信息劳动密集。我们开发并评估了EPPC-CARE，这是一个用于识别沟通行为并给出每个分类支持文本的自动化框架。【材料与方法】我们从867条消息中获得了5,516条参考标准标注。每条标注是由沟通相关文本（span）、较宽泛的沟通类别（Code）和具体子类别（Sub-code）组成的三元组。我们在六个开放权重大型语言模型（LLMs）中，将EPPC-CARE识别出的三元组与监督微调及基于沟通的模型（如EPPC-OASIS）进行比较。我们还在100条消息上将EPPC-CARE与人类专家标注进行比较。【结果】EPPC-CARE在所有六个模型上均优于EPPC-OASIS。EPPC-CARE的三元组F1平均提高2.90个百分点，最佳得分为64.4%。在人类专家评估子集上，EPPC-CARE与人类专家相对于参考标准表现出相当的一致性，差异倾向于EPPC-CARE。【讨论】这些发现表明，依次识别三元组组成部分（span、code、subcode）可在不同模型家族中提高性能，同时保留每次识别背后的支持文本。EPPC-CARE将沟通代码和子代码与源文本（span）关联，支持临床信息学中对自动标注的人工核查。因此，EPPC-CARE可能使更大规模的患者-提供者沟通研究更可行，并为人机协同（human-in-the-loop）标注工作流提供基础。【结论】EPPC-CARE为在安全的患者-提供者消息传递中自动表征沟通行为提供了一种更可靠且可复核的方法。

title: Train-Only-Constrained LM for Synthetic Clinical Trajectories: Leak-Safe Calibration and Auditable Dynamics
zh_title: 仅训练集约束语言模型生成合成临床轨迹
summary: 提出仅在训练集上拟合与校准的受限语言模型流程，用分位数token与逐生物标志物马尔可夫转移生成可审计的合成临床时间序列。
key_points: 小型GPT式模型学习分位数token的跨标志物共现
3x3马尔可夫转移约束时序方向并可在训练集审计
在5000例模拟测试台上比较经验采样器
reason: 预印本方法有新意且有基线对比，但仅在模拟测试台评估
abstract: Simulating clinical time series necessitates temporal realism, calibration that preserves model integrity, and privacy transparency. We present a train-only, constrained language-model pipeline that factorizes generation. A compact GPT-style language model learns cross-biomarker co-occurrence through quantile tokens, and temporal directions are enforced by 3x3 per-biomarker Markov transitions fit on TRAIN, allowing dynamics to be audited. We fit a monotone quantile map (QMap) on TRAIN only (SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)); no TEST statistics are used. The fixed map is then applied to SYN(TEST) severities. The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction. A classifier-based membership-inference audit results in an AUC of approximately 0.5; we make no differential-privacy claim. We present multi-seed results with paired 95% confidence intervals and quantify the severity of QMap's alignment (Delta W1 with confidence interval). This is a Stage-1 method result obtained on a controlled simulator; Stage-2 validation on real EHR cohorts with clinical endpoints is planned.
zh_abstract: 模拟临床时间序列需要时间真实性、保持模型完整性的校准以及隐私透明度。我们提出一种仅使用训练数据的、受约束的语言模型流水线，将生成过程因子化。一个紧凑的GPT风格语言模型通过分位数标记学习跨生物标志物共现，时间方向由在TRAIN上拟合的每个生物标志物3x3马尔可夫转移强制实现，从而使动态过程可审计。我们仅在TRAIN上拟合单调分位数映射（QMap）（SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)）；未使用任何TEST统计量。然后将固定映射应用于SYN(TEST)的严重程度。受约束的LM在5,000例患者模拟测试平台（参数处于已发表临床范围内）中，与经验采样器相比，表现出改善的分布保真度和共现，经小幅lambda扫描后仍保持接近随机水平的可检测性，并且按构造表现出时间依从性。基于分类器的成员推断审计得到约0.5的AUC；我们不作出差分隐私声明。我们呈现多随机种子结果及配对的95%置信区间，并量化QMap对齐的严重程度（Delta W1及置信区间）。这是在受控模拟器上获得的第1阶段方法结果；计划在具有临床终点的真实EHR队列上进行第2阶段验证。

title: EATS: Scaling Tool-Use Experience for Medical Reasoning Agents
zh_title: EATS：扩展医疗推理智能体的工具使用经验
summary: 预印本提出EATS，用历史工具调用轨迹构建记忆并检索，以改善医疗推理智能体的工具选择。
key_points: 构建含查询、工具、参数与自评反馈的记忆
无需真实标签监督即可扩展经验
针对神经工具输出不确定与分布漂移问题
reason: 有新意的智能体方法预印本，但条目未体现对比与外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine large language model (LLM) reasoning with clinical workflows and specialized neural tools. However, general-purpose LLMs receive limited training exposure to domain-specific medical tools, and the uncertainty and distributional shifts of neural tool outputs make selecting tools from simple descriptions significantly more challenging than in deterministic settings such as calculators or dictionary lookups. In this paper, we propose EATS, an experience-augmented tool selection strategy that leverages accumulated tool-use trajectories to improve tool selection in medical reasoning agents. EATS constructs a memory of past interactions, including queries, tool choices, arguments, and self-evaluated feedback, and retrieves relevant experiences to guide tool selection for new queries. As memory construction does not require ground-truth supervision, EATS scales naturally with test-time experience. We evaluate EATS on tool-augmented medical reasoning tasks, including closed-ended visual question answering and free-form report generation. Experiments on four public datasets, ChestAgentBench, CheXbench, MIMIC-CXR, and SLAKE-VQA, across three multimodal LLMs, Qwen3-VL 2B, Qwen3-VL 32B, and GPT-5.5, show consistent gains in tool selection behavior and downstream medical reasoning performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Limingyuan001/EATS.
zh_abstract: 医学推理智能体将大语言模型（large language model, LLM）推理与临床工作流程及专用神经工具相结合。然而，通用 LLM 对领域专用医学工具的训练暴露有限，且神经工具输出的不确定性和分布偏移，使得仅根据简单描述选择工具比在计算器或字典查找等确定性场景中显著更具挑战性。在本文中，我们提出 EATS，一种经验增强的工具选择策略，它利用累积的工具使用轨迹来改进医学推理智能体中的工具选择。EATS 构建过去交互的记忆，包括查询、工具选择、参数和自评估反馈，并检索相关经验来指导新查询的工具选择。由于记忆构建不需要真实标注监督，EATS 会随测试时经验自然扩展。我们在工具增强的医学推理任务上评估 EATS，包括封闭式视觉问答和自由形式报告生成。在四个公共数据集 ChestAgentBench、CheXbench、MIMIC-CXR 和 SLAKE-VQA 上，跨三种多模态 LLM（Qwen3-VL 2B、Qwen3-VL 32B 和 GPT-5.5）的实验显示，在工具选择行为和下游医学推理性能上均有一致提升。代码可在 https://github.com/Limingyuan001/EATS 获取。

title: PICE: Prototype-Informed Conditional Model Evolution Toward Self-Evolving Medical Image Recognition
zh_title: PICE：面向自演化医学图像识别的原型条件模型演化
summary: 预印本提出PICE框架，用原型统计记忆保留旧知识，在保护隐私、不保留历史图像的前提下持续扩展医学图像分类。
key_points: 以原型统计记忆保存既往疾病知识
评估新任务与历史参考的兼容性
仅在必要时扩展模型容量，避免线性增长
reason: 持续学习新方法预印本，问题设定有临床相关性，但条目未见外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Medical image classifiers in clinical practice must continually evolve to accommodate emerging disease categories while maintaining reliable classification of existing conditions. This is challenging because privacy and data-sharing restrictions limit access to historical patient data, while assigning dedicated capacity to each new diagnostic task causes linear model growth. Effective evolution requires preserving prior disease knowledge without retaining historical images while expanding model capacity only when necessary. To this end, we propose PICE, a Prototype-Informed Conditional Model Evolution framework organized around what to preserve, when evolution is needed, and how that evolution is realized. PICE preserves prior disease knowledge in a prototype-statistical memory. For each incoming task, it assesses compatibility with historical references reconstructed from memory, reusing the closest adapter when compatibility is sufficient and instantiating a new one when evolution is required. PICE then realizes evolution by updating the memory and recalibrating the unified classifier with Gaussian pseudo features, thereby integrating new knowledge into the cumulative diagnostic space. During inference, memory-derived similarities guide task-agnostic adapter selection and fusion, enabling prediction over all learned disease categories. Experiments on Skin8, Kvasir-V2, and Path16 demonstrate the effectiveness of PICE across diverse clinical scenarios. On Skin8, PICE achieves a 7.60\% improvement in accuracy over the SOTA method on new tasks, while maintaining 71.10\% accuracy on previous tasks. It also reduces additional learnable parameters by 18.51\%. These results indicate that PICE improves classification while balancing knowledge retention, adaptation, and parameter growth, supporting continual model evolution as new diagnostic categories emerge without access to historical images.
zh_abstract: 临床实践中的医学图像分类器必须持续演进，以适应新出现的疾病类别，同时保持对现有疾病的可靠分类。这具有挑战性，因为隐私和数据共享限制了对历史患者数据的访问，而为每个新诊断任务分配专用容量会导致模型线性增长。有效的演进需要在既不保留历史图像又保留既往疾病知识的情况下，仅在必要时扩展模型容量。为此，我们提出PICE（Prototype-Informed Conditional Model Evolution，原型知情条件模型演化）框架，围绕保留什么、何时需要演化以及如何实现演化来组织。PICE将既往疾病知识保存在原型-统计记忆（prototype-statistical memory）中。对于每个新来的任务，它评估其与从记忆重建的历史参考的兼容性；当兼容性足够时复用最接近的适配器，当需要演化时实例化一个新的适配器。然后，PICE通过更新记忆并用高斯伪特征重新校准统一分类器来实现演化，从而将新知识整合到累积诊断空间中。在推理过程中，由记忆导出的相似性指导任务无关的适配器选择和融合，从而能够对所有已学习的疾病类别进行预测。在Skin8、Kvasir-V2和Path16上的实验证明了PICE在不同临床场景中的有效性。在Skin8上，PICE在新任务上的准确率相比SOTA方法提高了7.60%，同时在先前任务上保持71.10%的准确率。它还将额外可学习参数减少了18.51%。这些结果表明，PICE在平衡知识保留、适应和参数增长的同时提高了分类性能，支持在无法访问历史图像的情况下随着新诊断类别的出现进行持续模型演化。

title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
zh_title: 选择性锚定：不完整测量下的病灶检测
summary: 提出选择性锚定方法，在生成先验重建未解析结构的同时保护可靠测量的图像成分，避免病灶被先验抹除。
key_points: 指出生成先验可能抹除待检病灶
对可靠测量成分施加确定性保护
可作为预训练扩散与流采样器的封装
reason: 预印本新方法有原理分析，但缺乏实际临床数据验证
abstract: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. Across sparse-view CT, accelerated brain MRI, and photoacoustic tomography, selective anchoring improves lesion contrast preservation and uncertainty reliability, and can reduce reconstruction error within lesions. For tumor detection in accelerated MRI, with a healthy reference estimated from the measurements alone, deterministic anchoring raises mean AUROC across eight samplers from 78.4% to 84.6% and lesion sensitivity at 0.25 false-positive marks per slice from 38.8% to 47.5%, with gains in all four predefined tumor-size groups. At thresholds frozen on healthy validation data, mean sensitivity rises from 20.2% to 44.1% (37.6% with stochastic anchoring). These findings show how expressive generative priors can reconstruct unresolved anatomy without healing away the abnormalities that the measurements support.
zh_abstract: 生成式先验能够从不完整的医学测量中恢复解剖细节，但可能抹去成像旨在检测的病灶本身，即使测量中包含这些病灶的证据。我们引入选择性锚定（selective anchoring），保护可靠测量的图像成分免受先验驱动的改变，同时允许表达力强的生成模型重建未解析结构。受保护成分的采集不确定性要么以确定性方式加入下游检验，要么通过读数的随机扰动由集成（ensemble）携带。我们将这一原理实现为预训练扩散和流采样器的包装器，以及 AnchoredFM——一种快速约束流模型。在线性-高斯测量模型下，受保护系数在期望上无偏，并在重复采集中达到名义区间覆盖率，且独立于所学先验。在稀疏视角 CT、加速脑 MRI 和光声断层成像中，选择性锚定改善病灶对比度保持和不确定性可靠性，并可降低病灶内重建误差。对于加速 MRI 中的肿瘤检测，在仅由测量估计健康参考的情况下，确定性锚定使八个采样器的平均 AUROC 从 78.4% 提高到 84.6%，并使每层 0.25 个假阳性标记处的病灶敏感性从 38.8% 提高到 47.5%，且在全部四个预定义肿瘤大小组中均有增益。在健康验证数据上冻结的阈值下，平均敏感性从 20.2% 升至 44.1%（随机锚定为 37.6%）。这些发现表明，表达力强的生成先验能够重建未解析解剖结构，而不会把测量所支持的异常“治愈”掉。

title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
zh_title: 运维日志中的身份与时序信号审计
summary: 提出两项数据集审计，在训练事件预测模型前量化日志中可识别个体身份与时序的信息量，并应用于含ICU脓毒症在内的七个公开数据集。
key_points: 两项审计在原假设下期望AUC为0.5
ICU中末次观测前向填充使身份AUC升至0.993
12小时脓毒症预测任务中前向填充虚增AUC约0.163
reason: 预印本方法学审计，揭示常见数据泄漏，但无临床验证
abstract: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. On a 12-hour sepsis forecasting task, carrying forward makes a model look 0.163 AUC better than raw values when a patient's hours are split between training and test, but only 0.046 better when patients are held out. The exaggeration under patient overlap also appears in a second ICU dataset with mortality as the outcome. On the sepsis task, a chronological control with complete follow-up, in which training sees only a patient's earlier, resolved hours, shows no positive mean overlap gap. Timing is a strong predictor: with complete follow-up, hour of stay and measurement counts alone, with no clinical value, score 0.761 on held-out patients, and adding the raw clinical values changes that by +0.018. Outside the ICU, 95% of drives and 75% of loans have records on both sides of a calendar cut, and the overlap gap persists under a calendar split. The audits show which features and preprocessing choices to check; the evaluation protocol decides the consequences. I release the code, a library that runs the audits on any table with a unit column and a time column, and a guide to using the audits.
zh_abstract: 从运行日志预测事件的模型——例如 ICU 记录中的脓毒症或硬盘故障——可以通过识别记录来自哪位患者或哪个硬盘，或记录时间，而不是预测事件本身，来获得良好评分。我引入两种简单审计，在任何事件预测模型训练之前衡量数据集携带多少此类信息，并将其应用于六个领域的七个公开数据集。一个审计询问分类器能否判断两条记录来自同一单元；另一个询问同一单元的两条记录中哪条更晚。在所述零假设下，两者的期望 AUC 均为 0.5。在 ICU 数据中，身份审计标记出一个常见预处理步骤：将最后一次测量向前填充使身份 AUC 从 0.916 升至 0.993。在 12 小时脓毒症预测任务中，当同一患者的小时数据被拆分到训练集和测试集时，向前填充使模型看起来比原始值好 0.163 AUC，但当患者被留出时仅好 0.046。患者重叠下的夸大效应也出现在第二个以死亡率为结局的 ICU 数据集中。在脓毒症任务中，采用完整随访的时间顺序对照——其中训练只看到患者较早且结局已明确的小时——未显示正的平均重叠差距。时间是强预测因子：在完整随访下，仅使用住院小时和测量次数、不含临床值，在留出患者上得分为 0.761，而加入原始临床值仅使其变化 +0.018。在 ICU 之外，95% 的硬盘和 75% 的贷款在日历切点两侧都有记录，且在按日历拆分时重叠差距仍然存在。审计显示应检查哪些特征和预处理选择；评估方案决定后果。我发布代码、一个可在任何具有单元列和时间列的表格上运行审计的库，以及使用审计的指南。

title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
zh_title: MedSkill-E²：医学智能体技能评估与进化框架
summary: 提出EBU-Bench基准，覆盖12类医学任务，衡量智能体自主使用技能的准确率差距。
key_points: 指出技能「可用但未被充分使用」现象EBU
构建EBU-Bench覆盖12个医学任务组
量化自主使用与明确引导下的技能使用差距
reason: 预印本新基准，任务覆盖较广但规模与开放性不明，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地使用技能来获取领域知识并完成真实世界任务。我们观察到，即使一项技能规定了任务所需的规则和程序，智能体在自主执行过程中仍可能无法有效应用这些规则和程序，我们将这一现象称为技能“启用但未充分使用”（Enable But Underuse，EBU）。这一问题在医学任务中尤为严重，因为忽略单个关键约束就可能产生看似合理但错误的结果。为评估并解决EBU，我们提出MedSkill-E$^{2}$，一个用于评估和演化医学智能体技能（skills）的框架。我们构建了EBU-Bench，一个具有挑战性的基准，涵盖12个医学相关任务组及相关技能，用于评估智能体自主使用可用技能的能力。我们将EBU差距量化为：自主使用技能与在明确指导下阅读并应用同一技能时，技能使用准确率之间的差异。在EBU-Bench上，所有被评估的模型-执行框架（model-harness）组合均表现出EBU，平均差距为43.94个百分点（pp）。对于同一模型，自主使用下的技能使用准确率在不同执行框架之间最多相差38.96 pp。受这些观察启发，我们提出EBU-Evolve，它利用自主使用和明确指导使用技能过程中的执行反馈，将有效指导提炼为可复用的技能指令。相对于演化前版本，修订后的技能在自主执行期间将技能使用准确率提高33.33至55.17 pp，并且在跨多个模型和执行框架迁移时继续带来提升。我们的结果表明，在模型和技能保持固定时，自主技能使用准确率会因执行框架而异，模型排名也可能发生变化。EBU即使在技能被打开后也可能持续存在。EBU-Evolve提高了同一技能内未见任务上的自主技能使用准确率，且增益可迁移到不同模型和执行框架。

title: Weakly Conditioned Diffusion Model Augmentation for Prostate Segmentation
zh_title: 弱条件扩散模型增强用于前列腺MRI分割
summary: 用掩膜条件扩散模型生成合成T2加权MRI增强nnU-Net训练，在LUND与MSD两个队列上评估。
key_points: 2.5D弱掩膜条件DDPM，按通道拼接条件
合成数据占比23%从头训练nnU-Net
在LUND（n=432）与MSD前列腺队列评估
reason: 预印本方法，两队列评估但仅分割指标，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep learning models for prostate MRI segmentation often struggle to generalize when trained on limited heterogeneous data, leading to boundary errors and over-segmentation. We present an augmentation framework using mask-conditioned synthetic and diverse T2-weighted MRI volumes to improve boundary precision and reduce over-segmentation. We employ a 2.5D weakly mask-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) via channel concatenation. The diffusion model conditions on stacks of adjacent binary masks from training folds. The model generates T2 volumes consistent with the conditioning anatomy while diversifying tissue appearance. We evaluate the proposed approach on two cohorts of data: (i) the LUND probe cohort (n=432) for strategy selection and training nnU-Net from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix, and (ii) the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) prostate cohort (n=32) evaluated with a 20% synthetic data mix. For the LUND cohort, we found that training an nnU-Net model from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix reduced the mean false-positive voxels per case from 11,102 (baseline) to 10,757. On the MSD cohort, the augmented model with a 20% synthetic mix achieved a mean cross-validated Dice of 0.9094, improving over the baseline (0.8935) by 1.59 percentage points and reducing mean false-positive voxels by 23.1% (4,201 to 3,229). Experimental results on both these cohorts suggest that mask-conditioned DDPM augmentation can reduce over-segmentation errors and improve boundary adherence in data-constrained settings.
zh_abstract: 用于前列腺MRI分割的深度学习模型在有限异质性数据上训练时往往难以泛化，导致边界误差和过度分割。我们提出一种增强框架，使用以掩膜为条件的合成且多样的T2加权MRI体数据，以提高边界精度并减少过度分割。我们通过通道拼接采用2.5D弱掩膜条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）。该扩散模型以来自训练折的相邻二值掩膜堆栈为条件。模型生成与条件解剖结构一致的T2体数据，同时使组织外观多样化。我们在两个数据队列上评估所提方法：（i）LUND探针队列（n=432），用于策略选择并以23%合成数据混合从头训练nnU-Net；（ii）医学分割十项全能（Medical Segmentation Decathlon，MSD）前列腺队列（n=32），以20%合成数据混合进行评估。对于LUND队列，我们发现以23%合成数据混合从头训练nnU-Net模型将每例平均假阳性体素从11,102（基线）降低至10,757。在MSD队列上，采用20%合成数据混合的增强模型获得平均交叉验证Dice为0.9094，较基线（0.8935）提高1.59个百分点，并将平均假阳性体素减少23.1%（从4,201降至3,229）。这两个队列的实验结果表明，在数据受限环境中，以掩膜为条件的DDPM增强可减少过度分割误差并改善边界贴合度。

title: EGSE: Evidence-Grounded Skill Evolution for Medical Reasoning Agents
zh_title: EGSE：医学推理智能体的证据接地技能进化
summary: 将相似病例历史对话蒸馏为可复用条件工作流，并迭代更新技能库以改进医学推理智能体。
key_points: 指出正确答案可能掩盖错误推理与工具使用
对比成功与失败轨迹提取经验与规避指引
经验综合为带适用条件的工作流与技能库
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但条目未见量化验证与外部评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine foundation models with specialized tools to interpret medical images, yet reusing their historical experience remains challenging. A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures. In this paper, we propose EGSE, an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a multi-faceted skill library through supported and validated updates to improve medical agents. EGSE evaluates intermediate reasoning and tool use and contrasts repeated successful and failed rollouts to extract useful practices and evidence-supported avoidance guidance. These experiences are synthesized into workflows with applicability conditions and checks traceable to source dialogues. Library additions and merges require source-grounded review and execution validation. At inference time, EGSE routes queries to skill nodes organized by imaging modality, question task type, and disease category, then retrieves and selects applicable workflows based on their conditions, the current images, and the question to guide evidence acquisition and interpretation. Experiments across four chest X-ray benchmarks show that EGSE outperforms representative medical agents and skill evolution methods in reasoning accuracy while reducing tool calls. It also delivers consistent accuracy gains across seven foundation models and supports skill transfer across datasets.
zh_abstract: 医学推理智能体将基础模型与专用工具相结合来解释医学图像，但复用其历史经验仍具挑战性。一个正确的最终答案可能掩盖有缺陷的推理或工具使用，综合生成的建议可能缺乏来源支持，而表面相似的病例可能需要不同的诊断流程。本文提出 EGSE，一个基于证据的技能演化框架，它将来自相似病例的历史对话提炼为可复用的条件工作流，并通过有支持且经过验证的更新逐步完善多面向技能库，以改进医学智能体。EGSE 评估中间推理和工具使用，并对比反复成功与失败的 rollout，以提取有用实践和证据支持的规避指导。这些经验被综合为带有适用条件且检查可追溯至来源对话的工作流。技能库的新增与合并需要基于来源的审查和执行验证。在推理时，EGSE 将查询路由到按成像模态、问题任务类型和疾病类别组织的技能节点，然后根据其条件、当前图像和问题检索并选择适用工作流，以指导证据获取和解释。在四个胸部 X 射线基准上的实验表明，EGSE 在推理准确率上优于代表性医学智能体和技能演化方法，同时减少工具调用。它还在七个基础模型上带来一致的准确率提升，并支持跨数据集的技能迁移。

title: Look at What Matters: Learning Lesion Prototypes from Severity Labels for Domain-Generalized Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
zh_title: 面向跨域泛化的糖尿病视网膜病变分级病灶原型学习
summary: 预印本仅用图像严重度标签学习多尺度病灶与背景原型，以序数评分加性组合出分级以提升跨域泛化。
key_points: 以分级临床含义构建多示例约束进行竞争式原型学习
分级仅由病灶原型响应得出，不设全局特征分类通路
引入图像退化下的教师引导保持与空间正则
reason: 预印本有新意的可解释方法，证据限于文中实验配置
abstract: Deep learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading often generalize poorly to unseen imaging domains, in part because predictions may exploit correlations specific to source datasets rather than retinal pathology. We address this challenge by constructing grading decisions from lesion evidence learned using only image severity labels. Clinical implications of DR grades provide multiple instance constraints that guide competitive learning of lesion and background prototypes at multiple scales. An additive ordinal scoring model then predicts severity exclusively from individual lesion prototype responses, explicitly connecting learned evidence with grading decisions without a global feature classification pathway. To improve the reliability of this evidence, we introduce teacher guided preservation under image degradations and spatial regularization against persistent coordinate preferences. Across six public DR datasets under a leave one domain out protocol, our method attains a mean quadratic weighted kappa of 0.761, outperforming the strongest competing method by 0.036. Localization and prototype removal analyses show that the learned responses align with retinal lesions and contribute to grading decisions. Experiments across five other prototype architectures and under image degradations further demonstrate the generality and robustness of the approach.
zh_abstract: 用于糖尿病视网膜病变（diabetic retinopathy, DR）分级的深度学习模型往往对未见成像域泛化很差，部分原因是预测可能利用源数据集特有的相关性而非视网膜病理。我们通过从仅使用图像严重程度标签学习到的病灶证据来构建分级决策，以应对这一挑战。DR 分级的临床意义提供了多示例约束，指导在多尺度上对病灶和背景原型进行竞争性学习。随后，一个加性有序评分模型仅根据个体病灶原型响应预测严重程度，明确将学习到的证据与分级决策联系起来，而无需全局特征分类通路。为提高该证据的可靠性，我们引入图像退化下的教师引导保持，以及对持续坐标偏好的空间正则化。在留一域（leave one domain out）协议下的六个公开 DR 数据集上，我们的方法达到平均二次加权 kappa 0.761，比最强竞争方法高 0.036。定位和原型移除分析表明，学习到的响应与视网膜病灶一致，并对分级决策有贡献。在另外五种原型架构上以及图像退化下的实验进一步证明了该方法的通用性和稳健性。

title: DoseSteer: Steering diffusion-based dose prediction models towards clinical targets via Dual-Response Guidance
zh_title: DoseSteer：推理期将扩散剂量预测导向临床靶区
summary: 预印本提出推理期框架，不改权重地引导已冻结的扩散剂量预测模型满足结构级临床剂量目标。
key_points: 免重训，在推理阶段对冻结模型施加引导
双响应引导按结构探测扰动响应并联立求解引导强度
覆盖三种扩散架构与三个数据集共五种配置
reason: 预印本新推理方法，多配置对比但缺前瞻临床验证
abstract: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy. Yet these predictions can still miss structure-level clinical dose targets. Once deployed, most existing predictors offer no direct mechanism to correct such deviations, deferring target enforcement to downstream plan optimization. We introduce DoseSteer, an inference-time framework that steers frozen diffusion-based dose prediction models towards specified clinical targets without retraining. To meet clinical targets while preserving overall dose prediction quality, we propose Dual-Response Guidance (DRG), a structure-centric algorithm that probes the model's responses to perturbations in each structure's noisy dose and context and jointly solves for per-structure steering strengths. Across five dataset-model configurations spanning three diffusion architectures and three datasets, DRG outperforms 12 training-free baselines under identical reference-derived target proxies, removing at least 97% of the target error, reducing the official dose error by 7.8% on average, and improving dose fidelity outside the steered structures. DoseSteer reconciles learned anatomical dose priors with explicit structure-level targets at test time, establishing a principled, training-free mechanism to refine AI dose predictions prior to plan optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/csp2002/DoseSteer.
zh_abstract: AI 剂量预测模型根据患者解剖结构生成患者特异性 3D 剂量分布。然而，这些预测仍可能错过结构层面的临床剂量目标。一旦部署，大多数现有预测器没有直接机制来纠正此类偏差，而是将目标强制执行推迟到下游计划优化。我们引入 DoseSteer，一个推理时框架，无需重新训练即可将冻结的基于扩散的剂量预测模型引导至指定的临床目标。为在保持整体剂量预测质量的同时满足临床目标，我们提出双响应引导（Dual-Response Guidance, DRG），一种以结构为中心的算法，它探查模型对各结构噪声剂量和上下文扰动的响应，并联合求解每个结构的引导强度。在涵盖三种扩散架构和三个数据集的五种数据集-模型配置中，DRG 在相同的参考衍生目标代理下优于 12 个无需训练的基线，消除至少 97% 的目标误差，将官方剂量误差平均降低 7.8%，并改善被引导结构之外的剂量保真度。DoseSteer 在测试时将学习到的解剖剂量先验与明确的结构级目标协调起来，建立了一种有原则的、无需训练的机制，在计划优化之前改进 AI 剂量预测。代码见 https://github.com/csp2002/DoseSteer。

title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
zh_title: 心理健康安全的结构化危害评估：是什么、涉及谁、何时
summary: 预印本提出临床依据的三维危害分类法，将危害刻画与干预决策分离，并经专家验证与LLM评审面板验证。
key_points: 从危害内容、涉及对象与发生时点三个维度刻画风险
安全策略以临床医生编写的显式指令置于模型权重之外
重标注公开基准发现其罕含指向用户的危害，而真实对话中近半
reason: 预印本分类框架有专家验证与新发现，但缺落地效果证据
abstract: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）在心理健康支持中的日益使用引发了重要的安全担忧。现有防护模型主要识别有害内容的类别，往往忽视判断适当回应所需的上下文。我们引入一个具有临床基础的分类体系，从三个维度刻画伤害：伤害是什么、涉及谁以及何时发生。它进一步将伤害刻画与干预决策分离，从而能够通过明确、由临床医生策划且可更新和审计的指令，在模型权重之外指定安全策略。我们与专家临床医生一起验证该分类体系，并验证一组LLM评判者以扩展标注。按该分类体系重新标注公开基准显示，这些基准很少包含针对用户的伤害，而后者在真实对话的伤害中占近一半。随后我们训练MindGuard2，这是一个35B-A3B、基于推理的防护模型，先对短推理轨迹进行监督微调，再使用带推理长度惩罚的强化学习，以在保留推理收益的同时最小化推理开销。在两个公开基准和真实世界对话上，MindGuard2达到的平衡准确率与规模大得多的GLM-5.3相当，而中位延迟约低10倍，推动了准确率-延迟帕累托前沿。此外，它在高召回率下实现低假阳性率，有助于在检测不安全情境的需求与可能干扰支持并削弱用户信任的不必要干预风险之间取得平衡。我们发布一个在合成数据上训练的具有SOTA性能的安全护栏模型，以及合成对话和按我们分类体系对公开基准的标注。

title: Rank Before You Encode: Reading a Few Percent of a Whole-Slide Image
zh_title: 先排序再编码：仅读取全切片图像的一小部分
summary: 在冻结全切片模型的前提下，用约3.3K参数的轻量选择器排序区域，只编码少量tile以降低病理推断成本。
key_points: 保持全包模型冻结，仅做tile选择
选择器拟合冻结模型注意力，无需额外切片标签
在六个任务七个聚合器上与九种高效方法比较
reason: 计算病理效率方向有新意且对比充分，但为预印本、无外部临床验证
abstract: Classifying a whole-slide image requires encoding thousands of high-resolution tiles with a pathology foundation model, which accounts for most of the inference cost. Existing efficient methods reduce this cost by selecting fewer tiles, but typically train a new model around their selection strategy. A largely unexplored alternative is to keep an existing full-bag model frozen and run it on selected tiles at the same encoder cost. We introduce this comparison, alongside random tile sampling at matched cost. To select tiles, we fit a lightweight selector with 3.3K parameters to the attention of a frozen model, without additional slide labels. The selector ranks regions from a slide thumbnail, encodes the top K regions at 5x magnification, and selects b for processing at 20x. We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six tasks and compare them with nine efficient methods trained on the same features and splits. At a budget of (K,b)=(1000,10), encoding costs about 6.6% of the full bag and is 10-14x faster, excluding tiling. The AUROC drop is no more than 0.005 in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs. At (500,10), the cost falls to about 4% and inference is 13-22x faster, but AUROC drops by up to 0.035 on CAMELYON17, where small metastases are easily missed. Selection improves over random sampling by about 0.10 AUROC on tasks with focal lesions, while random sampling performs well on diffuse tasks. In our comparisons, the frozen model at (500,10) is ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Giving an existing WSI model fewer tiles is thus a baseline that a new efficient model should be compared with at matched encoder cost.
zh_abstract: 对全切片图像（whole-slide image, WSI）进行分类，需要用病理基础模型编码数千个高分辨率图块，这占推断成本的大部分。现有高效方法通过选择更少的图块来降低这一成本，但通常围绕其选择策略训练一个新模型。一个很大程度上尚未探索的替代方案是：保持现有的全包（full-bag）模型冻结，并在相同编码器成本下让其对选中的图块运行。我们引入这一比较，并加入在匹配成本下的随机图块采样。为选择图块，我们将一个仅有 3.3K 参数的轻量选择器拟合到冻结模型的注意力上，且无需额外切片标签。该选择器从切片缩略图中对区域排序，以 5 倍放大编码前 K 个区域，并选择 b 个以 20 倍进行处理。我们在六项任务上评估七个冻结的多实例学习（MIL）聚合器，并将它们与在相同特征和数据划分上训练的九种高效方法进行比较。在预算 (K,b)=(1000,10) 下，编码成本约为全包的 6.6%，且（不含切块）快 10–14 倍。在 36 个聚合器-任务对中的 33 个里，AUROC 下降不超过 0.005。在 (500,10) 下，成本降至约 4%，推断快 13–22 倍，但在 CAMELYON17 上 AUROC 下降最多 0.035，其中小转移灶容易被漏检。在具有局灶性病变的任务上，选择比随机采样提高约 0.10 AUROC，而随机采样在弥漫性任务上表现良好。在我们的比较中，在 60 次配对比较中的 55 次里，(500,10) 下的冻结模型领先于九种高效方法。因此，给予现有 WSI 模型更少的图块是一个基线，新的高效模型应在匹配编码器成本下与之比较。

title: Where Does Free-Text 3D Grounding Fail? An Error Analysis of Report-Sentence Segmentation in Chest CT
zh_title: 胸部CT报告句子三维定位的错误分析
summary: 系统分析VoxTell在ReXGroundingCT验证集381条发现上的定位失败模式，并在隐藏测试集上复核。
key_points: 验证集200例扫描中成功定位53.5%的发现
错误多为范围过大、邻近病灶或小病灶漏检
去除方位词后性能减半，与仅标签提示相当
reason: 公开基准上的系统错误分析并含隐藏测试集，但无新方法，属值得一看档
abstract: Free-text 3D grounding, segmenting in a CT volume the region described by one sentence of the radiology report, could link reports to images at scale, but it is unclear where current models fail. We analyse the publicly released VoxTell model on all 381 findings of the 200-scan ReXGroundingCT validation set, where it grounds 53.5% of findings. Its failures are rarely about which lesion or side is meant. No miss lies on the side opposite to the one named, and findings are almost never confused with one another. Instead, predictions are too large, land on a neighbouring lesion on the correct side, or are missing for small findings, and diffuse findings are rarely grounded. Removing location words halves performance, to the level of label-only prompting, and anatomical rules derived from the sentence never improve the full-sentence output. The same pattern holds on the hidden 300-scan test set. Further progress therefore depends on extent estimation and small-lesion sensitivity rather than on anatomical post-processing.
zh_abstract: 自由文本三维定位（free-text 3D grounding），即在 CT 体积中分割放射学报告的一句话所描述的区域，可大规模地将报告与图像关联，但目前尚不清楚当前模型在何处失败。我们在公开发布的 VoxTell 模型上分析了 ReXGroundingCT 验证集全部 200 次扫描中的 381 个发现，该模型对 53.5% 的发现完成了定位。其失败很少涉及所指是哪个病变或哪一侧。没有遗漏位于所命名侧的对侧，且发现之间几乎从不相互混淆。相反，预测范围过大、落在正确侧的邻近病变上，或对小发现缺失，且弥漫性发现很少被定位。移除位置词会使性能减半，降至仅标签提示的水平，而从句中推导出的解剖规则从未改善完整句子的输出。同样的模式在隐藏的 300 次扫描测试集上成立。因此，进一步进展取决于范围估计和小病变敏感性，而不是解剖后处理。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
zh_title: 医学视觉推理的智能体强化学习框架MedPACT
summary: 提出MedPACT，用即时答案支持与前瞻引导两类信用分配学习选择性观察策略。
key_points: 单一视觉语言模型加图像-问题-答案监督
信用估计仅在训练阶段进行
将观测信用分配给对应工具调用token
reason: 新方法预印本，有基线对比但结果信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答（VQA）需要获取有用的证据并决定下一步观察何处。然而，最终答案奖励并不能揭示哪些观察支持作答，也不能指导后续的检查。我们提出 MedPACT，一个智能体强化学习框架，它通过即时答案支持与前瞻性引导来学习选择性观察策略。我们的内容控制估计器在共享的真实观察历史下，比较由真实观察与匹配的替代观察所诱导的下一步动作，从而分离出所观察内容如何改善后续决策。我们在 GRPO 中结合两种形式的信用，在轨迹级结果监督之外，将观察信用分配给相应的工具调用 token。MedPACT 使用单一视觉-语言模型和图像-问题-答案监督，信用估计仅限用于训练阶段。在六个医学 VQA 基准上使用 4B 和 8B 骨干网络的实验表明，准确率有所提高、分布外泛化能力强，且推理成本大幅降低。案例研究进一步说明 MedPACT 如何避免重复观察，并利用已获取的证据指导后续检查，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Typical Angina, Reversed: A Long-Standing Documentation Error in the UCI Heart Disease Data
zh_title: UCI心脏病数据胸痛变量记录方向被反转
summary: 指出UCI心脏病数据的胸痛编码与文档相反，编码4实为典型心绞痛，并给出两项验证。
key_points: 四个站点的编码4对应典型心绞痛特征
复现1986年Cleveland原始研究须用修正读法
另三个中心93–96%编码4患者具三项典型特征
reason: 影响广泛使用基准的数据错误，具实证核查，但非新AI方法，属值得一看档
abstract: The UCI Heart Disease data are a widely used machine-learning benchmark. We show that their chest-pain variable is stored in reverse of its documentation. At all four sites, the code documented as "asymptomatic" (4) marks patients with typical angina, and the code documented as "typical angina" (1) marks patients with almost none of the classical angina features (at Cleveland, no chest pain). Two complementary checks establish this: (i) the chest-pain table and regression coefficients of the original 1986 Cleveland study are reproduced only under the corrected reading; (ii) in the Budapest, Switzerland and Long Beach files, 93-96% of patients coded 4 have all three classical angina features. A 1990 word-labeled Cleveland file already uses the documented labels, and Statlog (Heart), a Cleveland subset, stores the same codes. OpenML, PMLB and two highly voted Kaggle copies that name the categories use the same documented labels (about 400,000 downloads combined). We audited a seeded random sample of 150 records from a pre-specified Scholar query for SHAP studies of these data mentioning asymptomatic chest pain (124 readable). Of 32 papers that state a direction for a named category, 25 (78%; 95% CI 61-89%) state one inconsistent with the corrected category identities; 22 (69%; 51-82%; post hoc) are attributable to the documentation error, and nine of these explain it clinically. None of the 124 readable papers identifies the reversal. Conventional models are essentially unaffected, one reason the error went unnoticed. Interpretations that attach the documented names to model effects are reversed, and zero-shot language-model classifiers that read the labels are misled: with the documented labels, three open-weight models lose 0.12-0.33 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) given age, sex and chest-pain type. We give the corrected mapping, evidence and code.
zh_abstract: UCI 心脏病数据集是广泛使用的机器学习基准。我们表明，其胸痛变量的存储方式与其文档记录相反。在所有四个站点中，文档记录为“无症状”（4）的代码标记的是典型心绞痛患者，而文档记录为“典型心绞痛”（1）的代码标记的是几乎没有典型心绞痛特征的患者（在克利夫兰，为无胸痛）。两项互补的检查确立了这一点：(i) 原始 1986 年克利夫兰研究的胸痛表和回归系数仅在修正后的解读下才能重现；(ii) 在布达佩斯、瑞士和长滩文件中，编码为 4 的患者中有 93-96% 具备全部三项典型心绞痛特征。一份 1990 年的文字标注克利夫兰文件已经使用了文档记录的标签，而 Statlog（Heart）——克利夫兰的一个子集——存储了相同的代码。OpenML、PMLB 以及两个命名了类别的得票很高的 Kaggle 副本使用了相同的文档标签（合计约 400,000 次下载）。我们审计了从预先指定的 Scholar 查询中抽取的 150 条记录的种子随机样本，该查询针对提及无症状胸痛的这些数据的 SHAP 研究（其中 124 条可读）。在 32 篇为某一命名类别说明方向的论文中，25 篇（78%；95% CI 61-89%）所述方向与修正后的类别身份不一致；22 篇（69%；51-82%；事后分析）可归因于文档错误，其中九篇从临床上对此进行了解释。124 篇可读论文中无一指出这一颠倒。传统模型基本不受影响，这是该错误未被注意到的原因之一。将文档名称附加到模型效应上的解读是颠倒的，而读取标签的零样本语言模型分类器会被误导：在给定年龄、性别和胸痛类型的情况下，使用文档标签时，三个开放权重模型在受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）上损失 0.12-0.33。我们给出了修正后的映射、证据和代码。

title: Probabilistic Monocular Biomechanical Reconstruction via Guided Flow Matching
zh_title: 单目视频概率化生物力学重建的引导流匹配方法
summary: 预印本提出生物力学流模型，用565名受试者多机位临床录像训练，仅凭单目2D关键点重建关节角度并给出不确定性。
key_points: 基于565名受试者多机位临床录像训练流匹配先验
测试时仅需单目2D关键点，无需配对视频训练
步行与TUG平均绝对关节角误差为3.91°和4.97°
与确定性轨迹优化器对比，角度精度相当
reason: 有新方法且与最先进优化器同场对比，但为预印本、仅精度指标，属值得一看档
abstract: Reconstructing 3D joint kinematics from a single video is ill-posed due to depth and stature ambiguity, limb occlusion, and missing uncertainty estimates. We introduce the Biomechanical Flow Model (BFM), a continuous-time flow-matching prior over subject anthropometry, anatomical joint-angle trajectories, and virtual markers, trained on multi-camera clinical recordings from 565 participants and steered toward monocular 2D keypoints at test time without paired video training. In a head-to-head comparison on the same clinical trials against a state-of-the-art deterministic trajectory optimizer fitting the identical skeleton, BFM achieves comparable joint-angle accuracy across walking and timed-up-and-go (TUG). Across held-out control, prosthetic, and neurologic participants, BFM reaches 3.91 deg and 4.97 deg mean absolute joint-angle error on walking and TUG while providing credible intervals that bridge temporal and whole-limb occlusions. Where keypoints are hidden, the intervals widen with the error and keep their coverage near nominal. Supplying individual anthropometric calibration removes most monocular pelvis depth error, whereas testing on out-of-distribution pediatric crouch gait produces biased, overconfident extension predictions, highlighting the need for pathologically diverse movement priors.
zh_abstract: 从单视频重建3D关节运动学是病态问题，原因包括深度和身材歧义、肢体遮挡以及缺失不确定性估计。我们引入生物力学流模型（BFM），这是一个关于受试者人体测量学、解剖关节角度轨迹和虚拟标记的连续时间流匹配先验，在来自565名参与者的多相机临床记录上训练，并在测试时被引导至单目2D关键点，而无需配对视频训练。在相同临床试验上，与拟合相同骨架的最先进确定性轨迹优化器进行直接比较，BFM 在步行和计时起立-行走（TUG）中取得相当的关节角度精度。在留出的对照、假肢和神经科参与者中，BFM 在步行和 TUG 上分别达到 3.91 度和 4.97 度平均绝对关节角度误差，同时提供可跨越时间和整肢遮挡的可信区间。在关键点被隐藏处，区间随误差增大而变宽，并保持其覆盖率接近标称值。提供个体人体测量学校准可消除大部分单目骨盆深度误差，而在分布外的小儿蹲伏步态上测试会产生有偏、过度自信的伸展预测，凸显了对病理多样性运动先验的需求。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Exercise Prediction, Monitoring, and Personalization: A Systematic Review.
source: PubMed · Journal of functional morphology and kinesiology
zh_title: AI在运动预测、监测与个性化中的系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020检索2015至2025年文献，系统综述AI/机器学习/深度学习在成人运动预测、监测与个性化处方中的应用及效果证据。
key_points: 检索PubMed与Scopus并辅以Google Scholar
按PICO框架设定纳入标准
指出应用效果证据仍呈异质性
reason: 系统综述但结论为证据异质，未达结论明确的高档
abstract: [Journal of functional morphology and kinesiology] Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to physiological prediction, physical activity monitoring, and personalized exercise prescription. However, evidence regarding its practical effectiveness remains heterogeneous. This systematic review examined applications of AI, machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL) in exercise-related prediction, monitoring, and personalization among adults. Methods: Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, PubMed and Scopus were searched for studies published between 2015 and 2025, with Google Scholar used as a supplementary source. Eligibility followed PICO: adults aged 18 years or older (P); AI, ML, or DL applications for exercise prediction, monitoring, or personalization (I); conventional or non-personalized approaches, where applicable (C); and predictive accuracy and physiological, functional, or behavioral exercise outcomes (O). Findings were synthesized descriptively. Results: Ten studies were included: four examined physiological or energy-expenditure prediction, two investigated activity-related behavioral outcomes, two evaluated training-response classification or recommendation generation, and two assessed AI-personalized exercise interventions. Predictive models demonstrated promising performance in specific applications, although validation procedures and populations varied substantially. The intervention studies reported greater perceived exercise intensity and satisfaction in one trial and improvements in selected measures of balance, flexibility, and strength in another. Conclusions: AI-based approaches show potential for supporting exercise assessment, monitoring, and individualized decision-making. However, evidence regarding their superiority over conventional exercise prescription remains limited by the small number of intervention studies, methodological heterogeneity, and insufficient external validation. Further well-designed, long-term intervention studies are needed to establish their comparative effectiveness and practical benefits.
zh_abstract: [Journal of functional morphology and kinesiology] 【背景】人工智能（AI）日益应用于生理预测、身体活动监测和个性化运动处方。然而，关于其实际有效性的证据仍存在异质性。本系统综述考察了AI、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）在成人运动相关预测、监测和个性化中的应用。【方法】遵循PRISMA 2020指南，检索PubMed和Scopus中2015年至2025年发表的研究，并以Google Scholar作为补充来源。纳入标准遵循PICO：成人年龄18岁及以上（P）；用于运动预测、监测或个性化的AI、ML或DL应用（I）；在适用情况下的传统或非个性化方法（C）；预测准确性以及生理、功能或行为方面的运动结局（O）。结果采用描述性方式综合。【结果】共纳入10项研究：4项考察生理或能量消耗预测，2项研究活动相关行为结局，2项评估训练反应分类或建议生成，2项评估AI个性化运动干预。预测模型在特定应用中表现出有前景的性能，尽管验证程序和人群差异很大。干预研究中，一项试验报告运动强度感知和满意度更高，另一项研究报告平衡、柔韧性和力量的部分指标有所改善。【结论】基于AI的方法在支持运动评估、监测和个体化决策方面显示出潜力。然而，关于其优于传统运动处方的证据仍受限于干预研究数量少、方法学异质性以及外部验证不足。需要进一步设计良好、长期的干预研究来确定其比较有效性和实际获益。

title: Annotation-Free Vision-Language Concept Bottleneck Models for Interpretable Medical Image Classification: A Review.
zh_title: 无标注视觉语言概念瓶颈模型用于可解释医学影像分类综述
summary: 综述梳理无需概念标注的视觉语言概念瓶颈模型，从CLIP、ALIGN、LLaVA基础到LaBo等无标签方法，并映射到放射、病理、心血管、皮肤与眼科。
key_points: 概念瓶颈模型可解释但依赖逐图概念标注
视觉语言模型可用大模型提概念、对比相似度打分
覆盖放射、病理、心血管、皮肤与眼科应用
reason: 同行评审综述，梳理无标注可解释影像分类路线，按规则综述最高6分
abstract: [Journal of imaging] Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) route predictions through a layer of human-understandable concepts, but classical CBMs need a concept label for every training image, a cost that is high in medicine. Vision-language models (VLMs) remove that requirement because, in a shared image-text embedding space, a large language model can propose candidate concepts and contrastive similarity can score them, with no concept labels. This review surveys annotation-free VLM-based CBMs and their move into clinical imaging. We cover vision-language foundations (CLIP, ALIGN, LLaVA) and trace concept models from early supervised methods (CBM, CEM, TCAV) to versions that work without manual labels (LaBo, Label-Free CBM, PCBM, OpenCBM, VLG-CBM). We then map these foundations to specific medical fields such as radiology, pathology, cardiology, dermatology, and ophthalmology, highlighting the medical VLM-CBMs closest to actual deployment (CBVLM, AdaCBM, ConcepPath, CBM-RAG). We focus on information leakage, in which task information reaches the prediction through the concept layer without being carried by the named concepts. Two of the seven surveyed medical VLM-CBMs test whether their predictions depend on individual concepts, but none measures leakage, and no shared protocol exists. We identify this gap as a central challenge for interpretable medical AI.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging] 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）将预测经由一层人类可理解的概念进行路由，但经典CBM需要为每张训练图像提供概念标签，这在医学中成本很高。视觉语言模型（VLM）消除了这一要求，因为在共享的图像-文本嵌入空间中，大语言模型可以提出候选概念，对比相似度可以对其评分，而无需概念标签。本综述调查了无需标注的基于VLM的CBM及其进入临床影像的进展。我们涵盖视觉语言基础（CLIP、ALIGN、LLaVA），并追溯概念模型从早期监督方法（CBM、CEM、TCAV）到无需人工标签即可工作的版本（LaBo、Label-Free CBM、PCBM、OpenCBM、VLG-CBM）。然后，我们将这些基础映射到特定医学领域，如放射学、病理学、心脏病学、皮肤病学和眼科学，重点介绍最接近实际部署的医学VLM-CBM（CBVLM、AdaCBM、ConcepPath、CBM-RAG）。我们关注信息泄漏，即任务信息通过概念层到达预测，但并未由命名概念承载。在调查的七个医学VLM-CBM中，有两个测试其预测是否依赖单个概念，但没有任何一个测量泄漏，也不存在共享方案。我们将这一缺口确定为可解释医学AI的核心挑战。

title: A noise-corrected metric for evaluating spatial transcriptomics predicted from histology
zh_title: 组织学预测空间转录组的噪声校正指标
summary: 提出可重复信号相关RSC指标，校正空间转录组稀疏计数噪声，重新评估组织学预测空间转录组的方法。
key_points: RSC拆分RNA计数区分信号与噪声
评估12个spot级与3个单细胞方法
多数模型仅捕捉宽泛组织模式
reason: 预印本提出新评价指标，方法有新意但证据有限。
abstract: Deep learning methods that predict spatial transcriptomics from histology offer scalable molecular profiling of clinical cohorts. However, conventional correlation metrics overstate prediction quality across whole sections by crediting models for recognizing broad tissue regions, and understate fine-scale prediction quality because sampling noise dominates sparse RNA counts. To resolve this, we introduce the reproducible-signal correlation (RSC) metric. RSC randomly splits RNA counts into two halves to separate reproducible signal from sampling noise across spatial scales and within tissue regions or cell classes. Across 12 spot-level and three single-cell methods, RSC revealed that most models capture broad tissue patterns but largely miss differences between neighboring spots or cells, which whole-section correlation overlooks. Within malignant cells, RSC distinguished methods that genuinely capture part of the cell-to-cell heterogeneity from those whose scores across all cells were inflated by cell-type composition. Guided by RSC, we designed a pairwise difference loss between neighboring spots that improved fine-scale predictions on average across 11 models. RSC thus provides a foundation for benchmarking predictions, guiding model design and determining which spatial analyses histology can support.
zh_abstract: 从组织学预测空间转录组学的深度学习方法为临床队列提供了可扩展的分子图谱分析。然而，传统相关性指标在整张切片范围内高估预测质量，因为它将识别广泛组织区域的能力归功于模型；同时，由于采样噪声主导稀疏RNA计数，这些指标又低估细尺度预测质量。为解决这一问题，我们引入可重复信号相关性（RSC）指标。RSC将RNA计数随机分成两半，以在空间尺度上以及组织区域或细胞类别内，将可重复信号与采样噪声分离。在12种spot水平和3种单细胞方法中，RSC揭示大多数模型捕获了广泛组织模式，但在很大程度上遗漏了相邻spot或细胞之间的差异，而整张切片相关性忽视了这一点。在恶性细胞内，RSC区分了真正捕获部分细胞间异质性的方法，与那些在所有细胞上的评分因细胞类型组成而被抬高的方法。在RSC指导下，我们设计了相邻spot之间的成对差异损失，在11个模型上平均改善了细尺度预测。因此，RSC为预测的基准测试、指导模型设计以及确定组织学能够支持哪些空间分析提供了基础。

title: VenusPheno: Transfer-Guided Task Grouping for Multi-Task Bacterial Phenotype Prediction
zh_title: VenusPheno：迁移引导的多任务细菌表型预测
summary: 预印本提出将 ProtT5 蛋白嵌入的多实例学习与迁移引导多任务学习结合，在 14 个细菌表型任务上评估。
key_points: Set Transformer 将基因组内蛋白聚合为基因组级表示
在 12178 个细菌基因组、14 个二分类表型任务上评估
采用按属划分的数据集切分，单任务训练优于对比方法
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比且样本规模大，但仅属计算评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Understanding how genomic information gives rise to bacterial phenotypes is a fundamental problem in biology. Genome-level prediction requires models that integrate information from thousands of proteins, while related phenotypes may share genomic signals. However, not all phenotype tasks benefit from being learned together, and suitable task groups can be difficult to define from biological knowledge alone. We present VenusPheno, a framework that combines multiple-instance learning over pretrained ProtT5 protein embeddings with transfer-guided multi-task learning. An attention-based Set Transformer aggregates the proteins in each genome into a genome-level representation. We evaluate VenusPheno on 14 binary phenotype tasks from 12,178 bacterial genomes using genus-disjoint splits. Under single-task training, VenusPheno outperforms computational, conventional machine-learning, and deep-learning baselines in terms of mean balanced accuracy. We then use leave-one-task-out analysis to estimate directed transfer relationship between phenotypes, revealing both beneficial and detrimental interactions. Grouping tasks based on these transfer relationships further improves mean balanced accuracy over independent training and joint training of all tasks. Although inferred without biological priors, the resulting groups are consistent with biologically plausible relationships among phenotypes. VenusPheno therefore combines accurate phenotype prediction with a data-driven strategy for determining which tasks should be learned together. The PyTorch implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/YJinling/VenusPheno.
zh_abstract: 理解基因组信息如何产生细菌表型是生物学中的一个基本问题。基因组水平预测需要模型整合来自数千种蛋白质的信息，而相关表型可能共享基因组信号。然而，并非所有表型任务都能从联合学习中获益，且仅凭生物学知识难以定义合适的任务组。我们提出 VenusPheno，这是一个将基于预训练 ProtT5 蛋白质嵌入的多实例学习与迁移引导的多任务学习相结合的框架。基于注意力的 Set Transformer 将每个基因组中的蛋白质聚合为基因组级表示。我们使用属不相交划分（genus-disjoint splits），在来自 12,178 个细菌基因组的 14 个二分类表型任务上评估 VenusPheno。在单任务训练下，VenusPheno 在平均平衡准确率（mean balanced accuracy）方面优于计算、传统机器学习和深度学习基线。然后，我们使用留一任务法（leave-one-task-out）分析来估计表型之间的有向迁移关系，揭示有益和有害的相互作用。基于这些迁移关系对任务进行分组，相比独立训练和所有任务联合训练，进一步提高了平均平衡准确率。尽管在没有生物学先验的情况下推断得到，所得分组与表型之间生物学上合理的关系一致。因此，VenusPheno 将准确的表型预测与一种数据驱动策略相结合，用于确定哪些任务应一起学习。PyTorch 实现已公开提供，网址为 https://github.com/YJinling/VenusPheno。

title: Artificial intelligence in ophthalmology: a bibliometric analysis of current status, hot topics, and trends (2016-2025).
zh_title: 眼科人工智能研究文献计量分析（2016-2025）
summary: 基于Web of Science 5798篇文献的文献计量分析，年发文量持续上升，2021年后进入稳定增长，中国发文量居首。

abstract: [International journal of ophthalmology] To systematically analyze the current state of research, evolving trends, and future directions regarding the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in ophthalmology from 2016 to 2025, thereby providing a reference for researchers in this field. The Web of Science Core Collection database was searched, and journal publications related to AI in ophthalmology published between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2025, were included. CiteSpace 6.3.1 was used to perform visual analyses of publication volume, distribution by country or region, research institutions and researchers, journal sources, keyword emergence, and high-impact publications. A total of 5798 research publications were included. The global annual publication volume showed a continuous upward trend, entering a period of stable growth after 2021. China ranked first globally with 1964 papers, followed by USA and India. University of London (204 papers), University College London (190 papers), and Sun Yat-sen University (190 papers) were the top three institutions by publication volume. Schmidt-Erfurth U (94 papers), Bogunovic H (86 papers), Yang WH (50 papers), and Wong TY (50 papers) were the leading researchers in terms of publication output. Research hotspots were highly concentrated on the automated screening and diagnosis of diabetic retinopathy (DR), with segmentation, retinal images, and feature extraction being the keywords with the highest growth rates. Analysis of high-impact papers further confirmed that DR screening is currently the most influential application scenario. Over the past decade, global research on AI in ophthalmology has developed rapidly, with China making particularly notable contributions in terms of publication volume. Research focus has shifted from traditional image processing methods to automated diagnosis using deep learning, with DR screening being the most mature application area.
zh_abstract: [International journal of ophthalmology] 系统分析2016年至2025年人工智能（AI）在眼科应用的研究现状、演变趋势和未来方向，从而为该领域研究人员提供参考。检索Web of Science核心合集数据库，纳入2016年1月1日至2025年12月31日发表的与AI在眼科应用相关的期刊文献。使用CiteSpace 6.3.1对发文量、国家或地区分布、研究机构与研究人员、期刊来源、关键词突现和高影响力论文进行可视化分析。共纳入5798篇研究文献。全球年度发文量呈持续上升趋势，2021年后进入稳定增长期。中国以1964篇论文位居全球第一，其次是美国（USA）和印度。University of London（204篇）、University College London（190篇）和Sun Yat-sen University（190篇）是发文量排名前三的机构。Schmidt-Erfurth U（94篇）、Bogunovic H（86篇）、Yang WH（50篇）和Wong TY（50篇）是发文产出领先的研究人员。研究热点高度集中于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）的自动化筛查与诊断，其中分割、视网膜图像和特征提取是增长率最高的关键词。对高影响力论文的分析进一步证实，DR筛查是目前最具影响力的应用场景。过去十年，全球AI在眼科的研究发展迅速，中国在发文量方面贡献尤为突出。研究重点已从传统图像处理方法转向使用深度学习的自动化诊断，其中DR筛查是最成熟的应用领域。

title: Treatment Selection in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Conceptual Framework for Precision Therapy.
zh_title: 胰腺导管腺癌治疗选择：精准治疗概念框架
summary: 综述提出胰腺癌精准治疗选择框架，提及AI、多组学与数字病理的潜在作用。
key_points: 转移性PDAC治疗选择仍主要依赖临床特征
KRAS等分子标志物导向治疗正在出现
提及AI、多组学与数字病理等前沿手段
reason: 同行评审综述，AI仅为框架中提及的一环，无实证，属增量偏上
abstract: [Journal of personalized medicine] Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains a major therapeutic challenge, with limited improvement in outcomes and substantial heterogeneity in treatment response. Systemic chemotherapy remains a cornerstone of treatment across disease stages, yet treatment selection, particularly in metastatic PDAC (mPDAC), is still driven predominantly by clinical characteristics, performance status, prior therapy, and a limited number of molecular biomarkers. The emergence of biomarker-directed therapies, including strategies targeting oncogenic KRAS alterations, demonstrates the potential of molecularly informed treatment selection but also highlights the need to identify which therapy is most likely to benefit an individual patient at a specific clinical decision point. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), multi-omics profiling, digital pathology, and prospective therapeutic trials provide an opportunity to develop comprehensive precision-treatment strategies. Existing AI approaches, including PASS-01/MULTIPL, PDACai, and CHAI, provide important foundations but remain constrained by limitations in prognostic versus predictive modeling, reliance on predominantly static or correlational representations, limited mechanistic interpretability, and incomplete integration of treatment effects and evolving tumor biology. In this narrative review, we propose a conceptual framework for individualized treatment selection in mPDAC that integrates multiscale biological and clinical data, mechanistic graph-based pathway representations, multimodal transformer models, and causal estimation of individualized treatment effects. This framework shifts AI-enabled precision oncology from static biomarker prediction toward mechanistically informed, uncertainty-aware, causally grounded treatment selection, with the potential to adapt as tumor biology, therapeutic options, and clinical evidence evolve. Although initially focused on mPDAC, the framework provides a generalizable architecture for individualized treatment selection across other biologically heterogeneous cancers.
zh_abstract: [Journal of personalized medicine] 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）仍是一项重大治疗挑战，其结局改善有限，且治疗反应存在显著异质性。全身化疗仍是各疾病阶段治疗的基石，但治疗选择，尤其是在转移性PDAC（mPDAC）中，仍主要取决于临床特征、体能状态、既往治疗和数量有限的分子生物标志物。生物标志物导向疗法的出现，包括靶向致癌性KRAS改变的策略，展示了分子信息指导治疗选择的潜力，但也突出表明需要确定在特定临床决策点哪种疗法最可能使个体患者获益。人工智能（AI）、多组学分析、数字病理学和前瞻性治疗试验的最新进展，为制定全面的精准治疗策略提供了机会。现有AI方法，包括PASS-01/MULTIPL、PDACai和CHAI，提供了重要基础，但仍受限于预后建模与预测建模方面的局限、对主要静态或相关性表示的依赖、机制可解释性有限，以及对治疗效应和不断演变的肿瘤生物学的整合不完整。在本叙述性综述中，我们提出了一个用于mPDAC个体化治疗选择的概念框架，该框架整合多尺度生物学和临床数据、基于机制图的通路表示、多模态Transformer模型以及个体化治疗效应的因果估计。该框架将AI赋能的精准肿瘤学从静态生物标志物预测转向机制知情、不确定性感知、因果基础的治疗选择，并具有随肿瘤生物学、治疗选择和临床证据演变而适应的潜力。尽管最初聚焦于mPDAC，该框架为其他生物学异质性癌症的个体化治疗选择提供了可推广的架构。

title: Explainable CNN Ensemble with AI-Generated Reporting for Fungal Infection Diagnosis.
zh_title: 可解释 CNN 集成与 AI 生成报告用于真菌感染诊断
summary: 同行评审研究用四种预训练 CNN 集成对真菌显微图像五分类，并生成可解释报告。
key_points: DenseNet121、ResNet18、VGG16、InceptionV3 集成分类
以 Grad-CAM、SHAP、LIME 与 Canny 边缘检测可视化
同时生成辅助诊断文本报告

abstract: [Journal of fungi (Basel, Switzerland)] The need for precise classification of fungi from microscopic images plays a critical role in diagnosing and treating patients since it requires timeliness and effectiveness. Nevertheless, manual examination is time-consuming and difficult due to the similar visual features of numerous fungi. Therefore, this work proposes a new approach to explainable deep learning for fungal image classification and report generation. The developed framework consists of four pre-trained convolutional neural network models-DenseNet121, ResNet18, VGG16, and InceptionV3-which are used to classify fungal microscopic images into five classes. To make the process more transparent, methods such as Grad-CAM, SHAP, LIME, and Canny edge detection are used to identify the areas of images that contribute to the prediction. At the same time, the developed approach uses the large language model LLaMA3-70B through LangChain and provides automatic generation of the structured diagnostic report, including fungal identification, confidence scores, and clinical observations. The whole pipeline is implemented using the Streamlit interface to predict and generate a PDF report of the classification. The experiments have been performed using publicly available data containing 5000 images of fungi with expert annotations. Among the models analyzed, DenseNet121 shows the highest result, reaching an accuracy of 99.75% and having the values of precision, recall, and F1-score close to 0.998.
zh_abstract: [Journal of fungi (Basel, Switzerland)] 从显微镜图像对真菌进行精确分类的需求在诊断和治疗患者中起着关键作用，因为这要求及时性和有效性。然而，由于众多真菌具有相似的视觉特征，人工检查耗时且困难。因此，本工作提出一种新的可解释深度学习方法，用于真菌图像分类和报告生成。所开发的框架由四个预训练卷积神经网络模型——DenseNet121、ResNet18、VGG16 和 InceptionV3——组成，用于将真菌显微镜图像分类为五类。为使过程更加透明，使用 Grad-CAM、SHAP、LIME 和 Canny 边缘检测等方法识别图像中对预测有贡献的区域。同时，所开发的方法通过 LangChain 使用大语言模型 LLaMA3-70B，并自动生成结构化诊断报告，包括真菌鉴定、置信度评分和临床观察。整个流程使用 Streamlit 界面实现，以进行预测并生成分类的 PDF 报告。实验使用公开可用数据完成，该数据包含 5000 张带有专家注释的真菌图像。在分析的模型中，DenseNet121 显示出最高结果，达到 99.75% 的准确率，且精确率、召回率和 F1 分数的值接近 0.998。

title: AI Agent Based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Nurses' Management of Postpartum Hemorrhage
