abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beni-Suef University; conditions: Postpartum Hemorrhage, Clinical Competence; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 62; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this randomized controlled trial is to find out whether an artificial intelligence (AI) agent based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves nurses' performance in managing postpartum hemorrhage (PPH). The participants are registered nurses working in the obstetric and gynecological ward, the obstetric emergency department and the critical care unit of Kafr Elsheikh General Hospital, Egypt. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Do nurses who use the RAG-based AI agent achieve higher performance scores in simulated PPH scenarios than nurses who use a printed guideline? 2. Do nurses who use the agent achieve higher PPH knowledge scores, complete more critical actions and perform them faster? Researchers will compare the intervention group, which receives PPH education plus training on and four weeks of access to the AI agent, with the control group, which receives the same PPH education and a printed guideline booklet based on the World Health Organization (WHO) 2025 recommendations. Participants will: * Complete a PPH knowledge questionnaire and perform a video-recorded simulated PPH scenario at baseline, immediately after the training and after four weeks. * Attend educational sessions on PPH (both groups) and training sessions on the AI agent (intervention group only). * Use the AI agent in daily practice for four weeks (intervention group only) and rate its usability at the end of the study.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Beni-Suef University；疾病/状况：产后出血、临床胜任力；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：62；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 这项随机对照试验的目标是查明基于检索增强生成（RAG）的人工智能（AI）智能体是否能改善护士管理产后出血（PPH）的表现。参与者是埃及Kafr Elsheikh总医院妇产科病房、产科急诊和重症监护病房工作的注册护士。该试验旨在回答的主要问题是：1. 使用基于RAG的AI智能体的护士在模拟PPH场景中是否比使用印刷版指南的护士获得更高的操作表现评分？2. 使用该智能体的护士是否获得更高的PPH知识评分、完成更多关键操作并更快地执行这些操作？研究者将比较干预组与对照组：干预组接受PPH教育以及AI智能体培训并获得为期四周的AI智能体使用权限；对照组接受相同的PPH教育以及基于世界卫生组织（WHO）2025年建议的印刷版指南手册。参与者将：* 在基线、培训后立即以及四周后完成PPH知识问卷并进行视频录制的模拟PPH场景操作。* 参加PPH教育课程（两组）和AI智能体培训课程（仅干预组）。* 在日常实践中使用AI智能体四周（仅干预组），并在研究结束时对其可用性进行评分。

title: Project LEO (Learn-Execute-Overcome): An LLM-driven CBT Journalling Supporter to Reduce Procrastination Among Young Adults

abstract: [Journal of food allergy] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly penetrated health care and begun to influence clinical care, research, and health system operations. With food allergy, AI offers promise for clinical decision support, personalized care guidance, support of health literacy and a drive toward novel therapies. Despite growing enthusiasm, there are currently no U.S. Food and Drug Administration-cleared AI tools specifically indicated for food allergy, which underscores the need for a structured approach for evaluating, selecting, and implementing AI solutions within the domain. This narrative review focuses on a pragmatic framework for AI tool selection tailored to food allergy use cases. I review the current state of AI in health care and allergy/immunology, describe key dimensions of tool selection, including clinical question definition, data suitability, performance trade-offs, user interaction, governance, and sustainability, and illustrate how these considerations may be applied to food allergy-relevant challenges. By shifting attention from model novelty to problem-solution fit, implementation readiness, and long-term stewardship, this framework aims to support clinicians, researchers, and health systems to responsibly leverage AI for improved patient outcomes.

abstract: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar images to the same fold during 5-fold group cross-validation. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) test on a fully held-out dataset was used to measure cross-dataset generalisation. Under a conventional random split, ShuffleNet achieved 97.1% accuracy with 1.2M parameters. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable (paired t-test, p = 0.19), and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs. On the held-out dataset, accuracy dropped for every model: EfficientNet-B0 generalised best (78.4%), while ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%. Glioma-meningioma confusion was the dominant error mode, and Grad-CAM maps showed that predictions were driven by tumour regions. These results indicate that in-distribution accuracy alone overstates real-world performance and that leakage-aware and cross-dataset evaluation should be reported alongside it.
zh_abstract: 从磁共振成像（MRI）中准确且早期地对脑肿瘤进行分类对于治疗计划至关重要，然而许多已发表的深度学习研究在小型、单一来源数据集上训练和测试，所报告的准确率可能在这些数据集之外不成立。本研究比较六种深度学习架构用于四分类（健康、脑膜瘤、胶质瘤和垂体瘤）：基线卷积神经网络（CNN）、基于注意力的CNN、ShuffleNet，以及增强卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）的EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50和Xception。模型在由四个公开可用MRI数据集汇编而成的语料库上训练。由于这些数据集不包含患者标识符，开发了一条考虑泄漏的流程，使用MD5哈希去除完全重复图像（550张图像），使用感知哈希去除近似重复图像（8,024张图像），并在5折分组交叉验证期间将视觉上相似的图像分配到同一折。在一个完全留出的数据集上进行留一数据集（LODO）测试，以衡量跨数据集泛化。在传统随机划分下，ShuffleNet以1.2M参数达到97.1%准确率。在考虑泄漏的分组K折交叉验证下，ShuffleNetV2（98.41%）和EfficientNet-B0（98.23%）在统计上无法区分（配对t检验，p = 0.19），且两者均显著优于自定义CNN。在留出数据集上，每个模型的准确率均下降：EfficientNet-B0泛化最佳（78.4%），而ShuffleNetV2降至66.2%。胶质瘤-脑膜瘤混淆是主要错误模式，Grad-CAM图显示预测由肿瘤区域驱动。这些结果表明，仅分布内准确率会高估真实世界性能，应与考虑泄漏的评估和跨数据集评估一同报告。

abstract: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.

abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Venous thromboembolism (VTE) continues to pose a substantial health issue worldwide, characterized by high rates of mortality and morbidity. The field of artificial intelligence (AI) has shown potential as a valuable asset for enhancing the detection and prediction of complex diseases, such as VTE. This review explores the role of AI in VTE prediction and diagnosis, analyzing various machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches, including natural language processing (NLP), support vector machines (SVM), random forests (RF), logistic regression (LR), gradient boosting methods, and deep learning frameworks such as ClotCatcher. Among the artificial intelligence models, those based on natural language processing algorithms, particularly ClotCatcher, demonstrated strong performance in analyzing unstructured clinical data. ClotCatcher achieved exceptional Area under the Curve (AUC) values of 0.980 and 0.995 for venous thromboembolism (VTE) adjudication from radiology reports. AI-driven methodologies facilitate early detection, personalized risk assessment, and enhanced patient outcomes. AI holds great potential for improving VTE diagnosis and risk assessment, offering greater accuracy and efficiency than traditional methods. However, further studies are required to validate these models across diverse populations and clinical environments. The integration of AI in VTE management represents a promising frontier in personalized medicine, potentially leading to improved outcomes and more efficient healthcare delivery.

abstract: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.
zh_abstract: 单细胞信息指导的解卷积为临床 bulk RNA 队列提供了细胞类型分辨的特征。现有大多数方法预测 K 个组成性细胞类型（cell types, CTs）的比例 $π_k$。较少方法预测细胞类型特异性表达（cell-type-specific expression, CTSE）$μ_{kg}$，即基因 g 在 CT k 中的表达；CTSE 可捕获比例所遗漏的细胞状态，但近期基准测试发现其难度大得多。我们用闭式精度界限解释这一差距。对于 CTSE，我们推导了逐基因线性估计器的 $R^2$ 上限。对于比例，跨基因汇集证据的最佳线性估计器具有闭式 $R^2$，其可计算下界可预测哪些 CT 可学习。我们研究了 106 个经生物学策展的（CT，基因）对的靶向解卷积，这些对在事后被发现具有更高的可学习性评分。在非小细胞肺癌的总生存期上，估计难度并不能预测这些靶标的预后价值。然而，基于解卷积特征的稀疏生存模型（主要为 CTSE）预测生存的效果与基于 bulk 基因本身的稀疏模型相当，同时将其信号归因于特定细胞类型。一些解卷积 CTSE 特征揭示了相应 bulk 基因中未见到的预后信号。

title: Feed-Forward Adaptive Gaussian Splatting for Interactive Medical Volume Rendering
zh_title: 用于交互式医学体绘制的自适应高斯泼溅
summary: 提出RenderFM-Next前馈模型，统一处理CT与MR体数据，支持无需重跑网络的传递函数编辑与精确裁剪以实现交互式渲染。
key_points: 单一网络同时支持CT与MR体数据
Gaussians每卷仅预测一次，改传递函数无需重算
裁剪面可直接精确切割Gaussians
reason: 预印本工程改进，聚焦渲染效率，临床相关性有限
abstract: Path-traced rendering shows CT and MR volumes with realistic lighting, but it restarts after every change of view, clipping plane or transfer function (TF), the map from voxel intensity to colour and opacity, which limits the frame rate. Feed-forward Gaussian splatting models such as RenderFM predict the Gaussians directly from the volume instead of fitting them to each scan, and are fast. RenderFM, however, handles only CT, runs its network again after every TF edit, has no clipping operator, and places its Gaussians on a uniform 3-mm grid that blurs organ boundaries and cut faces. We present RenderFM-Next, a feed-forward model that addresses these limits. One network handles both CT and MR. Its Gaussians are predicted once per volume: a new TF needs no pass of this network, and a clipping plane cuts them exactly, using operators from prior work. The model predicts coarse 3-mm Gaussians for the whole volume and refines them to 1.5 mm only where refinement improves the image. A small score head ranks the coarse Gaussians by how much refining them would reduce the rendering error; at render time the user chooses how many are refined, and those next to a clipping plane are always refined, which sharpens cut faces. We build a benchmark of about 2,000 CT and MR scans with path-traced references under clinical presets, TF edits and clipping. Our RenderFM-Next improves over RenderFM retrained on this benchmark by 2.8 dB on CT and 2.4 dB on MR and renders a 1600x1600 view in 4-6 ms. Refinement adds 0.30 / 0.69 dB over the same model trained without it (0.51 / 1.17 dB on cut faces), and refining a learned 10% of the coarse Gaussians matches a random 50% with 2.4x fewer Gaussians. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/renderfmnext/
zh_abstract: 路径追踪渲染能以逼真的光照显示CT和MR体数据，但每次改变视图、裁剪平面或传递函数（TF，即从体素强度到颜色和不透明度的映射）后都会重新开始，从而限制了帧率。前馈高斯泼溅模型如RenderFM直接从体数据预测高斯，而不是针对每次扫描拟合高斯，因此速度快。然而，RenderFM仅处理CT，每次编辑TF后都要再次运行其网络，没有裁剪算子，并将其高斯放置在均匀的3-mm网格上，这会模糊器官边界和切面。我们提出RenderFM-Next，一种解决这些限制的前馈模型。一个网络同时处理CT和MR。其高斯对每个体数据仅预测一次：新的TF无需再经过该网络，裁剪平面可使用先前工作中的算子精确切割这些高斯。该模型为整个体数据预测粗粒度3-mm高斯，并仅在细化能改善图像的位置将其细化到1.5 mm。一个小型评分头（score head）根据细化后能降低多少渲染误差对粗粒度高斯进行排序；渲染时用户选择细化多少个高斯，而靠近裁剪平面的高斯总是被细化，从而使切面更清晰。我们构建了一个包含约2,000个CT和MR扫描的基准，并在临床预设、TF编辑和裁剪下提供路径追踪参考。我们的RenderFM-Next在该基准上重新训练的RenderFM相比，在CT上提高2.8 dB，在MR上提高2.4 dB，并以4-6 ms渲染1600x1600视图。与未使用该细化训练的同一模型相比，细化在整体上增加0.30 / 0.69 dB（在切面上增加0.51 / 1.17 dB），并且细化学习到的10%粗粒度高斯即可匹配随机50%的细化效果，且高斯数量少2.4倍。项目页面：https://gaozhongpai.github.io/renderfmnext/

title: Multi-view fnirs identifies neurophysiological subtypes in post-stroke aphasia
zh_title: 多视角fNIRS识别卒中后失语神经生理亚型
summary: 对79例卒中后失语患者用静息与任务态fNIRS三个特征视角做无监督聚类，得到三个稳定亚型。
key_points: 融合静息活动与连接、任务激活、任务态重构三视角
聚类不纳入临床与行为量表
置换检验校正后仅三簇方案显著
reason: 单中心小样本无监督分型，仅内部稳定性检验，属增量档
abstract: Post-stroke aphasia is clinically heterogeneous, and conventional classifications may not capture differences in brain functional organisation. We tested whether resting-state and task-based functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) could identify neurophysiological subgroups alongside clinical assessment.Seventy-nine patients underwent unsupervised clustering using three fNIRS feature views: resting-state activity and connectivity, language-task activation, and rest-to-task connectivity reconfiguration. Similarity network fusion and spectral clustering integrated the views. Clinical and behavioural measures were excluded from clustering.Three clusters (n = 32, 17 and 30) were identified. This solution had the largest eigengap and was the only candidate significant after permutation testing and Holm correction (adjusted P = 0.001). It was stable under subsampling (mean adjusted Rand index, 0.773), but agreement fell to 0.217 when the resting-state view was removed. Clusters differed in most regional intrinsic-activity measures and all resting-state connectivity summaries, with few differences in task activation or connectivity reconfiguration. Their profiles showed higher right anterior prefrontal activity, distributed fronto-sensorimotor and parietal alterations, and reduced interhemispheric connectivity, respectively.Cluster membership was not significantly associated with conventional aphasia subtype (Cramér's V = 0.287), and baseline clinical language scores and task performance did not differ between clusters.These findings identify three neurophysiological subgroups distinguished mainly by intrinsic activity and resting-state functional connectivity, not clearly aligned with conventional aphasia classifications or baseline clinical measures. Multi-view fNIRS analysis may complement clinical characterisation, requiring independent and longitudinal validation.
zh_abstract: 卒中后失语症在临床上具有异质性，传统分类可能无法捕捉脑功能组织的差异。我们检验了静息态和任务态功能性近红外光谱（functional near-infrared spectroscopy, fNIRS）能否在临床评估之外识别神经生理亚组。79 例患者使用三个 fNIRS 特征视图进行无监督聚类：静息态活动与连接、语言任务激活，以及静息至任务的连接重构。相似性网络融合（similarity network fusion）和谱聚类整合了这些视图。临床和行为学指标被排除在聚类之外。识别出三个聚类（n = 32、17 和 30）。该解具有最大的特征间隙（eigengap），并且是置换检验和 Holm 校正后唯一显著的候选（校正 P = 0.001）。它在子采样下稳定（平均调整兰德指数 0.773），但当移除静息态视图后，一致性降至 0.217。各聚类在大多数区域内在活动指标和所有静息态连接汇总指标上存在差异，而在任务激活或连接重构方面差异很少。它们的特征分别表现为右侧前额叶前部活动更高、分布性额-感觉运动及顶叶改变，以及半球间连接性降低。聚类归属与常规失语症亚型无显著关联（Cramér's V = 0.287），且各聚类之间基线临床语言评分和任务表现无差异。这些发现识别出三个神经生理亚组，主要以内在大脑活动和静息态功能连接区分，并未与常规失语症分类或基线临床指标清晰对齐。多视图 fNIRS 分析可能补充临床表征，但需要独立且纵向的验证。

title: BreathSplat: Grounding One Smooth Motion in the Breathing Phase for 4D Cone-Beam CT
zh_title: BreathSplat：以呼吸相位约束4D-CBCT重建
summary: 用动态高斯与B样条表示4D容积与运动，把运动状态锚定于呼吸相位以跨周期共享投影。
key_points: 运动以B样条在空间与时间上参数化
呼吸相位取自常规替代信号
仅在模拟肺部扫描上验证
reason: 重建方法有新意，但仅模拟数据验证，属增量档
abstract: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D-CBCT) images the anatomy of a breathing patient, but sees each breathing phase from only a few angles. Breathing, however, is a smooth motion that repeats; it has a phase. Existing methods exploit this either by reconstructing the anatomy as a function of the breathing phase, often through bins, or by estimating smooth dynamic motions in time. Yet none of these grounds one smooth motion in the phase. We thus propose to share projections across breathing phases with splines. Specifically, we represent the 4D volume with dynamic Gaussians whose motion uses B-splines in space and time. We ground the motion state in the respiratory phase, which we read from well-studied conventional surrogates. Projections at the same phase in different breathing cycles then constrain the same anatomy and motion. On simulated lung scans, our method, BreathSplat, outperforms recent dynamic methods in reconstruction and motion accuracy, including those given the ground-truth phase. We further show qualitatively, on two real patient scans, that our method provides clearer reconstructions than the state of the art.
zh_abstract: 四维锥形束计算机断层扫描（4D-CBCT）对呼吸中的患者解剖结构进行成像，但每个呼吸相位仅能从少数角度观测。然而，呼吸是一种平滑且重复的运动；它具有相位。现有方法利用这一点，或是将解剖结构重建为呼吸相位的函数（通常通过分箱），或是估计时间上的平滑动态运动。然而，这些方法均未将单一平滑运动建立在相位之上。因此，我们提出使用样条在呼吸相位之间共享投影。具体而言，我们用动态高斯表示 4D 体，其运动在空间和时间上使用 B 样条。我们将运动状态建立在呼吸相位上，该相位从研究充分的传统替代信号中读取。随后，不同呼吸周期中同一相位的投影约束相同的解剖结构和运动。在模拟肺部扫描上，我们的方法 BreathSplat 在重建和运动准确性方面优于近期的动态方法，包括那些给定真实相位的方法。我们进一步在两例真实患者扫描上定性地表明，我们的方法比当前最先进方法提供更清晰的重建。

title: Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation
zh_title: 基础模型引导的连续伪标签加权乳腺超声域适应
summary: 用冻结的AutoSAMUS按确定性与一致性为EMA教师伪标签赋连续权重，做无监督域适应分割。
key_points: 每个目标像素权重落在0.5至1区间

abstract: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.
zh_abstract: 乳腺超声分割模型在不同扫描仪、机构和患者群体之间往往泛化不佳。我们研究用于无监督域适应（UDA）的连续基础模型引导的伪标签加权。指数移动平均（EMA）教师生成目标域伪标签，而冻结的超声分割模型（AutoSAMUS）使用有界权重调节其贡献，该权重结合了先验的确定性与该先验与教师模型的概率一致性。与我们早先的选择性 BiRP 规则相比，所提出的表述以 [0.5, 1] 内的权重监督每个目标像素，且测试时无需基础模型推理。我们在五个公开乳腺超声数据集上评估该方法，涵盖三个源域和十一个源-目标方向。在 TransUNet 协议下，连续加权在所有四个以 BUSI 为源的目标上优于全像素 EMA 和原始 BiRP，并在所有四个以 BUS-BRA 为源的目标上，在比较方法中取得最高平均 Dice 和最低 HD95。以 BrEaST 为源的结果不一：连续加权在 BUSI 上表现最佳，在 OASBUD 上与原始 BiRP 相当，而在 BUS-UCLM 上没有任何适应方法超过仅源域训练。在单独的 U-Net 流程中，仅一致性加权的表现与完整表述相当，使得先验确定性的增量价值仍未确定。由于加权规则是在检查了一些目标测试结果之后开发的，我们将该研究视为探索性研究，并报告不利以及有利的结果。

abstract: [Dentistry journal] Background/Objectives: The cross-sectional classification of mandibular growth-rotation morphology is relevant to orthodontic diagnosis and treatment planning, but conventional structural assessment is observer-dependent. This study developed and internally evaluated deep learning models for classifying existing clockwise and counterclockwise mandibular growth-rotation phenotypes on lateral cephalometric radiographs; it did not forecast future longitudinal growth. Methods: Eight hundred untreated radiographs from individuals aged 9-20 years were labelled by consensus using Björk and Skieller morphological indicators (clockwise, n = 376; counterclockwise, n = 424). A stratified 80:20 training-validation split was used. ResNet50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 were fine-tuned after Gaussian noise reduction, min-max normalisation, and limited geometric augmentation. Results: VGG16 showed the most favourable validation accuracy-loss profile. The archived aggregate confusion matrix (n = 800) yielded an apparent accuracy of 81.13% (95% CI, 78.38-83.75) and balanced accuracy of 81.32% (95% CI, 78.62-83.96); recall was 84.57% for clockwise and 78.07% for counterclockwise phenotypes. Because the matrix included the complete labelled cohort, these values are descriptive apparent performance and not an independent test estimate. Conclusions: VGG16 can classify cross-sectional mandibular growth-rotation phenotypes with promising apparent performance. External, longitudinal, and observer-benchmark validation is required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Dentistry journal] 【背景/目的】下颌骨生长旋转形态的横断面分类与正畸诊断和治疗计划相关，但传统结构评估依赖观察者。本研究开发并内部评估深度学习模型，用于在侧位头影测量放射照片上对现存的顺时针和逆时针下颌骨生长旋转表型进行分类；它并未预测未来的纵向生长。【方法】八百张来自 9-20 岁个体的未治疗放射照片由共识使用 Björk 和 Skieller 形态学指标进行标注（顺时针，n = 376；逆时针，n = 424）。采用分层 80:20 训练-验证划分。ResNet50、InceptionV3 和 VGG16 在高斯噪声降噪、最小-最大归一化和有限几何增强后进行微调。【结果】VGG16 显示出最有利的验证准确率-损失表现。归档的聚合混淆矩阵（n = 800）得出表观准确率为 81.13%（95% CI，78.38-83.75），平衡准确率为 81.32%（95% CI，78.62-83.96）；顺时针表型的召回率为 84.57%，逆时针表型为 78.07%。由于该矩阵包含完整的标注队列，这些值是描述性表观性能，而非独立测试估计。【结论】VGG16 能以有前景的表观性能对横断面下颌骨生长旋转表型进行分类。在临床使用前，需要外部、纵向和观察者基准验证。

abstract: Purpose: Figure retrieval from reference atlases in expert domains like forensic pathology, dentistry and geology must work without labels or training pairs, on content that often cannot leave local hardware, and on images outside the training data of image-text encoders. This work proposes a structure-aware pipeline that satisfies all three, retrieving figures through the page structure recovered by layout geometry and a local open-weight 8B VLM. Methods: A geometry-based pairing method is introduced, in which the model receives a schematic of the detected boxes and selects each picture's caption without access to pixels or text. Caption retrieval is evaluated on three private corpora (29 books, 10,421 figures, 218 queries) with blind human grading, against a lexical baseline, generated descriptions and five image-text encoders. Results: Geometric pairing was correct for 96%, 92% and 77% of pictures in the three domains, against 76%, 45% and 53% for the better of two document parsers. A hosted model given the schematic was equally accurate, while coordinates as text lost 22 points. Caption retrieval obtained an nDCG@5 of 0.85, 0.87 and 0.76, against 0.54, 0.51 and 0.27 for the best cross-modal encoder and 0.41, 0.28 and 0.30 for generated descriptions. Pairing errors carried over to retrieval. Conclusion: The proposed pipeline achieves accurate figure retrieval with small local models and no in-domain training, where general and biomedical image-text encoders fall far behind. Its geometry-only pairing is the most accurate of five methods and exposes no content, even to a hosted model. Code and prompts are released.

abstract: Echocardiographic images are frequently degraded by spatially structured haze artifacts that obscure anatomical boundaries and hinder clinical analysis. Conventional diffusion models typically employ pixel-independent Gaussian noise, limiting their ability to represent localized ultrasound haze. In this study, we propose a structure-informed diffusion framework that explicitly models ultrasound haze as an accumulation of localized Gaussian components constrained by the ultrasound fan geometry. The forward process generates spatially correlated corruption by sampling component locations and scales, providing a formulation that better reflects the spatial characteristics of real echo artifacts. During reverse restoration, a dual-head network predicts an anchor probability map and Gaussian scale parameters to progressively remove structured artifacts while reducing the center bias associated with direct coordinate regression. We evaluated the framework on the public DehazingEcho2025 benchmark and two private clinical datasets, without retraining or fine-tuning on either private cohort. Our method achieved the highest mean generalized contrast-to-noise ratio across all three datasets, reaching $0.715 \pm 0.090$ on the public benchmark while preserving tissue edges.
zh_abstract: 超声心动图图像经常受到空间结构化雾状伪影的降质，这些伪影遮蔽解剖边界并阻碍临床分析。传统扩散模型通常采用像素独立的高斯噪声，限制了其表示局部超声雾状伪影的能力。本研究提出一种结构信息扩散框架，将超声雾状伪影显式建模为由超声扇形几何约束的局部高斯分量累积。前向过程通过采样分量位置和尺度生成空间相关的退化，提供了一种更好反映真实回声伪影空间特性的表述。在反向恢复过程中，双头网络预测锚点概率图和高斯尺度参数，以逐步去除结构化伪影，同时减少与直接坐标回归相关的中心偏置。我们在公开的 DehazingEcho2025 基准和两个私有临床数据集上评估该框架，未在两个私有队列中的任何一个上重新训练或微调。我们的方法在所有三个数据集上取得了最高的平均广义对比噪声比，在公开基准上达到 $0.715 \pm 0.090$，同时保留组织边缘。

title: Using waveform types, discrete Sobolev distances, and trend compatibility to cluster short time series of clinical data

abstract: Clinical tests, such as the oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT), perturb a physiological system at rest and record its excursion over a fixed protocol window as a short, undersampled time series. Such curves rarely allow parameter identification at the individual level, yet their trends carry physiological information that emerges at the population level as recurrent response patterns. Standard clustering methods aggregate differences globally and average out those trends, losing precisely the information about how the system regains control after the perturbation; identifying response patterns requires a method that preserves them. We present a nonparametric framework that factorizes each curve into unit waveforms, sorts them with a symbolic trend-compatibility filter, and compares compatible shapes using discrete Sobolev-type distances on finite differences up to order $k$. The number of clusters, i.e., distinct response types, equals the number of realizable trend patterns the cohort populates, validated by resampling. Applied to 1283 five-point OGTTs, the method identifies 7 glycemia and 8 insulinemia types. The count holds across a threefold range of resolution. In benchmarks against six classical clustering methods, ours alone never mixes opposite trends, with comparable reconstruction error and stability. Clinical normality, assessed after clustering, is graded, overlapping, and distributed unevenly across response types ($h=0.14$--$0.48$). Overall, our method distinguishes response types among curves too short for alignment-based methods yet too informative for reduction to summary values. It applies to any protocol recording a system's response to a standardized perturbation on a short grid.
zh_abstract: 口服葡萄糖耐量试验（oral glucose tolerance test, OGTT）等临床测试在静息状态下扰动生理系统，并在固定方案窗口内记录其偏移，形成短的、欠采样时间序列。此类曲线很少能够在个体水平进行参数辨识，但其趋势携带生理信息，这些信息在群体水平上以重复出现的反应模式显现。标准聚类方法在全局上聚合差异并将这些趋势平均掉，恰恰丢失了关于系统在扰动后如何重新获得控制的信息；识别反应模式需要一种能够保留这些趋势的方法。我们提出一个非参数框架，将每条曲线分解为单位波形，使用符号趋势兼容性过滤器对其排序，并使用基于最高至 $k$ 阶有限差分的离散 Sobolev 型距离比较兼容形状。聚类数，即不同反应类型的数目，等于队列所填充的可实现趋势模式数，并通过重采样验证。应用于 1283 条五点 OGTT，该方法识别出 7 种血糖类型和 8 种胰岛素血症类型。该数量在分辨率三倍范围内保持稳定。在与六种经典聚类方法的基准比较中，仅我们的方法从不混合相反趋势，且重建误差和稳定性相当。临床正常性在聚类后评估，呈分级、重叠分布，并在不同反应类型间分布不均（$h=0.14$--$0.48$）。总体而言，我们的方法能够区分那些对于基于对齐的方法而言过短、但信息量又不足以简化为汇总值的曲线之间的反应类型。它适用于任何在短网格上记录系统对标准化扰动反应的方案。
